```ts
    // ============================================
    // STATISTICS & AGGREGATION
    // ============================================

    /**
     * Get payment statistics for dashboard
     * Optimized to fetch only required fields
     */
    async getPaymentStats(): Promise<{
        totalPayments: number;
        completedPayments: number;
        pendingPayments: number;
        duplicateRefundCount: number;
        unresolvedReviewCount: number;
        refundDeniedCount?: number;
        totalRevenue: number;
        onlinePayments: number;
        offlinePayments: number;
    }> {
        if (!this.isReady()) {
            return { totalPayments: 0, completedPayments: 0, pendingPayments: 0, duplicateRefundCount: 0, unresolvedReviewCount: 0, refundDeniedCount: 0, totalRevenue: 0, onlinePayments: 0, offlinePayments: 0 };
        }

        try {
            // 1. Primary path: Fast database-side aggregation RPC (O(1) transfer, immune to PostgREST row limits)
            const { data: rpcData, error: rpcError } = await this.supabase
                .rpc('get_payment_analytics_aggregates')
                .maybeSingle();

            if (!rpcError && rpcData) {
                const rpcStats = rpcData as any;
                return {
                    totalPayments: Number(rpcStats.total_payments || 0),
                    completedPayments: Number(rpcStats.completed_payments || 0),
                    pendingPayments: Number(rpcStats.pending_payments || 0),
                    duplicateRefundCount: Number(rpcStats.duplicate_refund_count || 0),
                    unresolvedReviewCount: Number(rpcStats.unresolved_review_count || 0),
                    refundDeniedCount: Number(rpcStats.refund_denied_count || 0),
                    totalRevenue: Number(rpcStats.total_revenue || 0),
                    onlinePayments: Number(rpcStats.online_payments || 0),
                    offlinePayments: Number(rpcStats.offline_payments || 0),
                };
            }

            // 2. Fallback path: Explicit chunked pagination across complete dataset
            // Prevents silent truncation at PostgREST default 1,000-row limit
            const pageSize = 1000;
            let offset = 0;
            let totalPayments = 0;
            let completedCount = 0;
            let pendingCount = 0;
            let duplicateRefundCount = 0;
            let unresolvedReviewCount = 0;
            let refundDeniedCount = 0;
            let totalRevenue = 0;
            let onlineCount = 0;
            let offlineCount = 0;

            while (true) {
                const { data, error } = await this.supabase
                    .from('payments')
                    .select('status, amount, method')
                    .order('created_at', { ascending: true })
                    .range(offset, offset + pageSize - 1);

                if (error) {
                    console.error(`[PaymentsSupabaseService] Stats fetch error at offset ${offset}:`, error);
                    throw new Error(`Failed to fetch payment stats at offset ${offset}: ${error.message}`);
                }

                const page = data || [];
                totalPayments += page.length;

                for (const p of page) {
                    const isCompleted = p.status === 'Completed' || (p.status || '').toLowerCase() === 'completed';
                    const isPending = p.status === 'Pending' || (p.status || '').toLowerCase() === 'pending';
                    const isDuplicateRefund = p.status === 'Duplicate_Pending_Refund' || (p.status || '').toLowerCase() === 'duplicate_pending_refund';
                    const isUnresolvedReview = p.status === 'Captured_Pending_Review' || (p.status || '').toLowerCase() === 'captured_pending_review';
                    const isRefundDenied = p.status === 'Refund_Denied' || (p.status || '').toLowerCase() === 'refund_denied';

                    if (isCompleted) {
                        completedCount++;
                        totalRevenue += (p.amount || 0);

                        if (p.method === 'Online' || (p.method || '').toLowerCase() === 'online') {
                            onlineCount++;
                        } else if (p.method === 'Offline' || (p.method || '').toLowerCase() === 'offline') {
                            offlineCount++;
                        }
                    } else if (isPending) {
                        pendingCount++;
                    } else if (isDuplicateRefund) {
                        duplicateRefundCount++;
                    } else if (isUnresolvedReview) {
                        unresolvedReviewCount++;
                    } else if (isRefundDenied) {
                        refundDeniedCount++;
                    }
                }

                if (page.length < pageSize) {
                    break;
                }
                offset += pageSize;
            }

            return {
                totalPayments,
                completedPayments: completedCount,
                pendingPayments: pendingCount,
                duplicateRefundCount,
                unresolvedReviewCount,
                refundDeniedCount,
                totalRevenue,
                onlinePayments: onlineCount,
                offlinePayments: offlineCount,
            };
        } catch (error: unknown) {
            console.error('[PaymentsSupabaseService] Stats error:', error);
            throw error;
        }
    }

    /**
     * Get payment method preference trend (Online vs Offline)
     */
    async getPaymentMethodTrend(): Promise<{ name: string; value: number; color: string }[]> {
        if (!this.isReady()) return [];

        try {
            const { data, error } = await this.supabase
                .from('payments')
                .select('method')
                .or('status.eq.Completed,status.eq.completed');

            if (error) return [];

            const online = data.filter(p => (p.method || '').toLowerCase() === 'online').length;
            const offline = data.filter(p => (p.method || '').toLowerCase() === 'offline').length;

            return [
                { name: 'Online Payments', value: online, color: '#6366f1' },
                { name: 'Offline Payments', value: offline, color: '#10b981' }
            ];
        } catch {
            return [];
        }
    }

    /**
     * Get payment trend for the last 7 days (Daily Revenue)
     */
    async getPaymentTrend(): Promise<{ date: string; amount: number }[]> {
        if (!this.isReady()) return [];

        try {
            const last7Days = Array.from({ length: 7 }, (_, i) => {
                const d = new Date();
                d.setDate(d.getDate() - (6 - i));
                d.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0);
                return d;
            });

            // Start from 8 days ago UTC to ensure local time zone coverage
            const startDate = new Date(Date.now() - 8 * 86400000).toISOString();

            const { data, error } = await this.supabase
                .from('payments')
                .select('amount, transaction_date')
                .in('status', ['Completed', 'completed'])
                .gte('transaction_date', startDate)
                .order('transaction_date', { ascending: true });

            if (error) {
                console.error('[PaymentsSupabaseService] Trend error:', error);
                return [];
            }

            const payments = data || [];

            return last7Days.map(day => {
                const dateStr = day.toLocaleDateString('en-US', { month: 'short', day: 'numeric' });

                const dayTotal = payments
                    .filter(p => {
                        if (!p.transaction_date) return false;
                        const pDate = new Date(p.transaction_date);
                        return pDate.getFullYear() === day.getFullYear() &&
                               pDate.getMonth() === day.getMonth() &&
                               pDate.getDate() === day.getDate();
                    })
                    .reduce((sum, p) => sum + Number(p.amount || 0), 0);

                return {
                    date: dateStr,
                    amount: dayTotal
                };
            });
        } catch (err) {
            console.error('[PaymentsSupabaseService] Trend exception:', err);
            return [];
        }
    }

    /**
     * Get payment trend for the last 6 months (Monthly Revenue)
     */
    async getPaymentTrendMonthly(): Promise<{ date: string; amount: number }[]> {
        if (!this.isReady()) return [];

        try {
            // Generate last 6 months - Set date to 1st first to avoid overflow when setting month
            const last6Months = Array.from({ length: 6 }, (_, i) => {
                const d = new Date();
                d.setDate(1); // Set to 1st first to avoid month-end overflow
                d.setMonth(d.getMonth() - (5 - i));
                d.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0);
                return d;
            });

            const startDate = last6Months[0].toISOString();

            const { data, error } = await this.supabase
                .from('payments')
                .select('amount, transaction_date')
                .in('status', ['Completed', 'completed'])
                .gte('transaction_date', startDate)
                .order('transaction_date', { ascending: true });

            if (error) {
                console.error('[PaymentsSupabaseService] Monthly trend error:', error);
                return [];
            }

            const payments = data || [];

            return last6Months.map(month => {
                const dateStr = month.toLocaleDateString('en-US', { month: 'short', year: '2-digit' });

                const monthTotal = payments
                    .filter(p => {
                        if (!p.transaction_date) return false;
                        const pDate = new Date(p.transaction_date);
                        return pDate.getFullYear() === month.getFullYear() &&
                               pDate.getMonth() === month.getMonth();
                    })
                    .reduce((sum, p) => sum + Number(p.amount || 0), 0);

                return {
                    date: dateStr,
                    amount: monthTotal
                };
            });
        } catch (err) {
            console.error('[PaymentsSupabaseService] Monthly trend exception:', err);
            return [];
        }
    }

    /**
     * Retrieve recent pending orders that have an associated Razorpay order ID
     * for automated background reconciliation sweeps.
     */
    async getRecentPendingOrders(hours = 48): Promise<{ data: any[] | null; error: any }> {
        if (!this.isReady()) {
            return { data: [], error: null };
        }

        try {
            const cutoffDate = new Date(Date.now() - hours * 3600 * 1000).toISOString();
            const { data, error } = await this.supabase
                .from('payments')
                .select('payment_id, student_uid, student_id, student_name, razorpay_order_id, razorpay_payment_id, amount, status, created_at')
                .eq('status', 'Pending')
                .not('razorpay_order_id', 'is', null)
                .gte('created_at', cutoffDate)
                .order('created_at', { ascending: false })
                .limit(100);

            if (error) {
                console.error('[PaymentsSupabaseService] getRecentPendingOrders query error:', error);
                return { data: null, error };
            }

            return { data: data || [], error: null };
        } catch (err) {
            console.error('[PaymentsSupabaseService] getRecentPendingOrders exception:', err);
            return { data: null, error: err };
        }
    }

    /**
     * Update metadata on an existing payment record (e.g. tracking entitlement lifecycle).
     * Safe on Completed payments: metadata is explicitly permitted by protect_completed_payments.
     */
    async updatePaymentMetadata(
        paymentId: string,
        metadataUpdates: Record<string, unknown>,
        options?: {
            expectedClaimTime?: string;
        }
    ): Promise<boolean> {
        if (!this.isReady()) return false;

        try {
            const current = (await this.getPaymentById(paymentId)) || (await this.getPaymentByRazorpayId(paymentId));
            if (!current) {
                console.warn(`[PaymentsSupabaseService] Payment ${paymentId} not found for metadata update`);
                return false;
            }

            // CRITICAL INVARIANT: An already-active (healed) entitlement must NEVER be downgraded by recovery sweeps.
            // Explicit transitions (e.g. application rejection marking unconsumed) are permitted.
            const currentStatus = current.metadata?.entitlement_status;
            const newStatus = metadataUpdates.entitlement_status;
            const allowTransition = Boolean(
                (options as any)?.allowEntitlementStatusTransition ||
                newStatus === 'application_rejected_unconsumed'
            );

            if (currentStatus === 'active' && newStatus && newStatus !== 'active' && !allowTransition) {
                console.warn(`[PaymentsSupabaseService] Refusing to downgrade active entitlement for ${paymentId} to ${newStatus}`);
                return false;
            }

            // Lease verification: If a specific lease claim timestamp was expected, verify worker still owns it
            if (options?.expectedClaimTime && current.metadata?.recovering_since !== options.expectedClaimTime) {
                console.warn(`[PaymentsSupabaseService] Lease ownership lost for ${paymentId} (expected ${options.expectedClaimTime}, current ${current.metadata?.recovering_since})`);
                return false;
            }

            const updatedMetadata = {
                ...(current.metadata || {}),
                ...metadataUpdates,
                last_metadata_update: new Date().toISOString(),
            };

            let query = this.supabase
                .from('payments')
                .update({ metadata: updatedMetadata })
                .eq('payment_id', current.payment_id);

            // DB-level guard: If not setting to active and not explicit transition, never overwrite a row that became active concurrently.
            // NULL-safe: permits rows where metadata is NULL or entitlement_status is NULL or non-active.
            if (newStatus && newStatus !== 'active' && !allowTransition) {
                query = query.or('metadata.is.null,metadata->>entitlement_status.is.null,metadata->>entitlement_status.neq.active');
            }

            if (options?.expectedClaimTime) {
                query = query.eq('metadata->>recovering_since', options.expectedClaimTime);
            }

            const { data, error } = await query.select('payment_id');

            if (error) {
                console.error('[PaymentsSupabaseService] updatePaymentMetadata error:', error);
                return false;
            }

            // CRITICAL VERIFICATION: Ensure the conditional update actually changed a row.
            // If another worker acquired ownership or the state changed concurrently, PostgREST returns 0 rows.
            if (!data || (Array.isArray(data) && data.length === 0)) {
                console.warn(`[PaymentsSupabaseService] updatePaymentMetadata matched 0 rows for ${paymentId} (concurrent lease loss or state changed)`);
                return false;
            }

            return true;
        } catch (err) {
            console.error('[PaymentsSupabaseService] updatePaymentMetadata exception:', err);
            return false;
        }
    }

    /**
     * Retrieve completed payments with incomplete entitlement status
     * for automated background self-healing.
     * 
     * INVARIANT: No long-running failure may become permanently stranded by aging out.
     * Queries both recent window (<= hours) and durable backlog of unhealed failures (> hours).
     * Partitions the limit quota fairly between recent window and backlog so neither starves.
     */
    async getCompletedPaymentsWithPendingEntitlements(hours = 72, limit = 100): Promise<{ data: any[] | null; error: any }> {
        if (!this.isReady()) {
            return { data: [], error: null };
        }

        try {
            const cutoffDate = new Date(Date.now() - hours * 3600 * 1000).toISOString();
            // Lease timeout: stale 'recovering' leases older than 5 minutes are eligible for retry
            const leaseThresholdISO = new Date(Date.now() - 5 * 60 * 1000).toISOString();

            // Fair quota partition: partition limit equally between recent window and older backlog
            const batchQuota = Math.max(1, Math.floor(limit / 2));

            // 1. Recent window query: captures recent completed payments with pending/failed entitlements.
            // Uses .or() to discover rows with null metadata, null entitlement_status, or non-active status,
            // filtering out already-active entitlements at the DB level before limiting results.
            // Includes pending_registration_submission so submitted registration payments are discovered.
            const { data: recentData, error: recentErr } = await this.supabase
                .from('payments')
                .select(PAYMENT_COLUMNS)
                .eq('status', 'Completed')
                .gte('created_at', cutoffDate)
                .or('metadata.is.null,metadata->>entitlement_status.is.null,metadata->>entitlement_status.neq.active')
                .order('created_at', { ascending: false })
                .limit(batchQuota);

            if (recentErr) {
                console.error('[PaymentsSupabaseService] getCompletedPaymentsWithPendingEntitlements recent query error:', recentErr);
                return { data: null, error: recentErr };
            }

            // 2. Durable backlog query: captures unhealed failures older than cutoffDate so they are NEVER permanently stranded.
            // FAIR PROGRESSION & RETRY BACKOFF: To prevent a persistently failing oldest batch from starving later unresolved records,
            // we filter out records whose next_retry_after is still in the future.
            const nowIso = new Date().toISOString();
            const { data: backlogData, error: backlogErr } = await this.supabase
                .from('payments')
                .select(PAYMENT_COLUMNS)
                .eq('status', 'Completed')
                .lt('created_at', cutoffDate)
                .or('metadata.is.null,metadata->>entitlement_status.is.null,metadata->>entitlement_status.neq.active')
                .or(`metadata->>next_retry_after.is.null,metadata->>next_retry_after.lte.${nowIso}`)
                .order('created_at', { ascending: true })
                .limit(batchQuota);

            if (backlogErr) {
                console.error('[PaymentsSupabaseService] getCompletedPaymentsWithPendingEntitlements backlog query error:', backlogErr);
                return { data: null, error: backlogErr };
            }

            const combined = [...(recentData || []), ...(backlogData || [])];
            const seen = new Set<string>();
            const pendingEntitlements: any[] = [];

            for (const p of combined) {
                if (!p?.payment_id || seen.has(p.payment_id)) continue;
                seen.add(p.payment_id);

                // Backoff check: skip records whose backoff window has not elapsed
                if (p.metadata?.next_retry_after) {
                    const retryAfter = new Date(String(p.metadata.next_retry_after)).getTime();
                    if (Date.now() < retryAfter) {
                        continue;
                    }
                }

                const entStatus = p.metadata?.entitlement_status;
                // Null/undefined entitlement_status means it was never set — treat as pending
                const isPending = !entStatus ||
                    entStatus === 'failed' ||
                    entStatus === 'pending_application' ||
                    entStatus === 'pending' ||
                    entStatus === 'pending_registration_submission';

                if (isPending) {
                    pendingEntitlements.push(this.decryptRecord(p));
                    continue;
                }

                if (entStatus === 'recovering') {
                    // Only include stale leases (worker crashed without releasing)
                    const recoveringSince = p.metadata?.recovering_since
                        ? new Date(String(p.metadata.recovering_since)).getTime()
                        : 0;
                    if (Date.now() - recoveringSince >= 5 * 60 * 1000) {
                        pendingEntitlements.push(this.decryptRecord(p));
                    }
                    // else: fresh lease held by active worker — skip
                }
            }

            return { data: pendingEntitlements, error: null };
        } catch (err) {
            console.error('[PaymentsSupabaseService] getCompletedPaymentsWithPendingEntitlements exception:', err);
            return { data: null, error: err };
        }
    }

    /**
     * Cross-instance lease coordination for background entitlement recovery.
     * Prevents multiple concurrent serverless instances or workers from processing
     * the same payment entitlement simultaneously.
     *
     * ATOMICITY GUARANTEE: The lease conditions are enforced inside the UPDATE WHERE clause,
     * not in application-level if-checks before the UPDATE. This eliminates the TOCTOU race
     * where two concurrent workers both read 'not recovering', both decide to proceed, and both
     * write the lease — only to process the same payment twice.
     *
     * The UPDATE only executes (and returns a row) when PostgreSQL verifies:
     *   - entitlement_status IS NOT 'active'  (already fully healed — skip)
     *   - entitlement_status IS NOT 'recovering' OR the lease is stale (worker crashed)
     * If another worker already claimed the lease, this UPDATE matches 0 rows → data is null → returns { claimed: false }.
     */
    async claimPaymentForEntitlementRecovery(
        paymentId: string,
        leaseTimeoutMs = 5 * 60 * 1000
    ): Promise<{ claimed: boolean; leaseTime?: string; reason?: 'actively_leased' | 'already_active' | 'not_found' | 'error'; error?: any }> {
        if (!this.isReady()) return { claimed: false };

        try {
            // Fetch current record to merge existing metadata into the claim payload.
            // This read is safe: the atomicity guard is in the UPDATE WHERE clause below,
            // not in application-side conditional checks.
            const current = (await this.getPaymentById(paymentId)) || (await this.getPaymentByRazorpayId(paymentId));
            if (!current) {
                console.warn(`[PaymentsSupabaseService] Payment ${paymentId} not found for recovery claim`);
                return { claimed: false, reason: 'not_found' };
            }

            const leaseThresholdISO = new Date(Date.now() - leaseTimeoutMs).toISOString();

            // Fast-path bailout: If already active or actively leased, avoid database write lock
            if (current.metadata?.entitlement_status === 'active') {
                return { claimed: false, reason: 'already_active' };
            }
            if (current.metadata?.entitlement_status === 'recovering') {
                const recoveringSince = current.metadata?.recovering_since
                    ? new Date(String(current.metadata.recovering_since)).getTime()
                    : 0;
                if (Date.now() - recoveringSince < leaseTimeoutMs) {
                    return { claimed: false, reason: 'actively_leased' };
                }
            }

            const claimTimestamp = new Date().toISOString();
            const claimMetadata = {
                ...(current.metadata || {}),
                entitlement_status: 'recovering',
                recovering_since: claimTimestamp,
                last_metadata_update: claimTimestamp,
            };

            // ATOMIC CAS: embed all lease conditions directly in the UPDATE WHERE clause.
            // PostgreSQL evaluates this atomically; no gap exists between read and write.
            //
            // Conditions translated to PostgREST:
            //   (metadata->>'entitlement_status' != 'active')               — never overwrite healed
            //   AND (
            //     metadata->>'entitlement_status' != 'recovering'           — unclaimed, OR
            //     OR metadata->>'recovering_since' < leaseThresholdISO      — stale crashed lease
            //   )
            const { data, error } = await this.supabase
                .from('payments')
                .update({ metadata: claimMetadata })
                .eq('payment_id', current.payment_id)
                // Guard 1 & 2 combined with NULL-safety:
                // Evaluates atomically in PostgREST/PostgreSQL:
                // 1. Unclaimed: metadata is NULL, entitlement_status is NULL, or entitlement_status is not 'active' and not 'recovering'
                // 2. Stale lease: entitlement_status is 'recovering', but recovering_since is older than leaseThresholdISO
                // 3. Never claims: rows where entitlement_status is 'active', or rows actively leased by another worker
                .or(`metadata.is.null,metadata->>entitlement_status.is.null,and(metadata->>entitlement_status.neq.active,metadata->>entitlement_status.neq.recovering),and(metadata->>entitlement_status.neq.active,metadata->>recovering_since.lt.${leaseThresholdISO})`)
                .select('payment_id')
                .maybeSingle();

            if (error) {
                console.warn('[PaymentsSupabaseService] Failed to establish recovery lease:', error);
                return { claimed: false, error, reason: 'error' };
            }

            if (!data) {
                // UPDATE matched 0 rows: another worker already holds a fresh lease, or the
                // payment is already active. Both are correct reasons to skip.
                return { claimed: false, reason: 'actively_leased' };
            }

            return { claimed: true, leaseTime: claimTimestamp };
        } catch (err) {
            console.error('[PaymentsSupabaseService] claimPaymentForEntitlementRecovery exception:', err);
            return { claimed: false, error: err, reason: 'error' };
        }
    }

    /**
     * Retrieve stale pending orders created MORE than `olderThanHours` ago
     * to prevent captures older than 48 hours from being permanently abandoned.
     */
    async getStalePendingOrders(olderThanHours = 48, limit = 50): Promise<{ data: any[] | null; error: any }> {
        if (!this.isReady()) {
            return { data: [], error: null };
        }

        try {
            const cutoffDate = new Date(Date.now() - olderThanHours * 3600 * 1000).toISOString();
            const { data, error } = await this.supabase
                .from('payments')
                .select('payment_id, student_uid, student_id, student_name, razorpay_order_id, razorpay_payment_id, amount, status, created_at, metadata')
                .eq('status', 'Pending')
                .not('razorpay_order_id', 'is', null)
                .lt('created_at', cutoffDate)
                .order('created_at', { ascending: true })
                .limit(limit);

            if (error) {
                console.error('[PaymentsSupabaseService] getStalePendingOrders error:', error);
                return { data: null, error };
            }

            return { data: data || [], error: null };
        } catch (err) {
            console.error('[PaymentsSupabaseService] getStalePendingOrders exception:', err);
            return { data: null, error: err };
        }
    }
}

// Export singleton instance
export const paymentsSupabaseService = new PaymentsSupabaseService();

// Export class for custom instantiation
export { PaymentsSupabaseService };
```

```ts
 * Canonical frontend payment state model
 *
 * Five user-facing states. Raw Razorpay codes are stored internally for logs
 * but NEVER exposed to students.
 */

// ─── Five canonical frontend states ──────────────────────────────────────────

/**
 * UI-ONLY display state. Lives exclusively in React component state and the
 * recovery hook. Must NEVER be written to:
 *  - Supabase payments table
 *  - Firestore documents
 *  - localStorage PaymentSession.status
 *  - Any database or audit log
 *
 * Database/business statuses are: 'Pending' | 'Completed' | 'Failed'
 * (Supabase) and 'pending' | 'processing' | 'completed' | 'failed'
 * (PaymentSession in localStorage). Those are orthogonal to this type.
 */
export type PaymentFrontendStatus =
  | 'success'
  | 'processing'
  | 'failed'
  | 'banking_issue'
  | 'verification_pending'
  | 'duplicate_pending_refund'
  | 'captured_pending_review'
  | 'refund_denied';

/**
 * Canonical database/ledger payment status (Supabase).
 * This is what actually gets persisted — completely separate from
 * PaymentFrontendStatus.
 */
// FIX-07 (A-14): Added 'Rejected' — payments-supabase.ts writes 'Rejected' when
// an application is rejected (rejectApplicationPayment), but the type previously
// only included 'Failed'. This mismatch broke type safety and any status-equality
// check that expected 'Failed' to match a rejected payment record.
export type PaymentDatabaseStatus =
  | 'Pending'
  | 'Completed'
  | 'Failed'
  | 'Rejected'
  | 'Duplicate_Pending_Refund'
  | 'Captured_Pending_Review'
  | 'Refunded'
  | 'Refund_Denied';

/**

 * Also completely separate from PaymentFrontendStatus.
 */
export type PaymentSessionStatus = 'pending' | 'processing' | 'completed' | 'failed';

// ─── Internal Razorpay reason → frontend state map ───────────────────────────

const FAILED_REASONS = new Set([
  'insufficient_fund',
  'payment_cancelled',
  'card_declined',
  'authentication_failed',
  'card_disabled_for_online_payments',
  'card_number_invalid',
  // additional normalized variants
  'BAD_REQUEST_ERROR',
  'user_cancelled',
]);

const BANKING_ISSUE_REASONS = new Set([
  'payment_timed_out',
  'gateway_technical_error',
  'GATEWAY_ERROR',
  'SERVER_ERROR',
]);

/**
 * Map a Razorpay error code/reason to one of the five frontend states.
 * Source: from payment.failed event on Razorpay checkout.
 */
export function mapRazorpayErrorToState(
  errorCode?: string,
  errorReason?: string
): PaymentFrontendStatus {
  const reason = (errorReason || '').toLowerCase();
  const code = (errorCode || '').toLowerCase();

  // Explicit failed reasons
  if (
    FAILED_REASONS.has(errorReason || '') ||
    FAILED_REASONS.has(code) ||
    reason === 'payment_cancelled' ||
    reason === 'user_cancelled' ||
    reason === 'insufficient_fund' ||
    reason === 'card_declined' ||
    reason === 'authentication_failed' ||
    reason === 'card_disabled_for_online_payments' ||
    reason === 'card_number_invalid'
  ) {
    return 'failed';
  }

  // Banking issue reasons
  if (
    BANKING_ISSUE_REASONS.has(errorReason || '') ||
    BANKING_ISSUE_REASONS.has(code) ||
    reason === 'payment_timed_out' ||
    reason === 'gateway_technical_error'
  ) {
    return 'banking_issue';
  }

  // User dismissed / cancelled modal explicitly
  if (errorCode === 'USER_CANCELLED') {
    return 'failed';
  }

  // Unknown → default to failed for gateway checkout failures
  return 'failed';
}

/**
 * Map a /api/payment/recover API response `status` field → frontend UI state.
 *
 * NOTE: This is the only place the recover API's `status` string is consumed.
 * The string is NEVER forwarded to any database — it exists solely as a
 * transport value between the API and this mapping function.
 * `verification_pending` in particular must remain a UI-only concept.
 */
export function mapRecoverStatusToState(
  apiStatus: string
): PaymentFrontendStatus {
  switch (apiStatus) {
    case 'success':
    case 'already_processed':
      return 'success';
    case 'duplicate_pending_refund':
    case 'Duplicate_Pending_Refund':
      return 'duplicate_pending_refund';
    case 'captured_pending_review':
    case 'Captured_Pending_Review':
      return 'captured_pending_review';
    case 'refund_denied':
    case 'Refund_Denied':
      return 'refund_denied';
    case 'processing':
      return 'processing';
    case 'failed':
      return 'failed';
    case 'not_found':
      return 'failed'; // No payment found — safe to retry
    default:
      return 'verification_pending';
  }
}

/**
 * Get highly detailed, student-friendly, and actionable status messages
 * based on the frontend status, error code, and error reason.
 */
export function getFriendlyPaymentStateContent(
  status: PaymentFrontendStatus,
  errorCode?: string,
  errorReason?: string
): PaymentStateContent {
  const reason = (errorReason || '').toLowerCase();
  const code = (errorCode || '').toLowerCase();

  if (status === 'failed') {
    // 1. Payment Cancelled
    if (
      reason === 'payment_cancelled' ||
      reason === 'user_cancelled' ||
      code === 'user_cancelled' ||
      errorCode === 'USER_CANCELLED'
    ) {
      return {
        title: 'Payment Cancelled',
        lines: [
          'The transaction was cancelled before completion.',
          'No money was debited from your account.',
          'You can safely try again whenever you are ready.',
        ],
      };
    }

    // 2. Insufficient Funds
    if (reason === 'insufficient_fund' || code === 'insufficient_fund') {
      return {
        title: 'Insufficient Balance',
        lines: [
          'The transaction failed because there are insufficient funds in your account.',
          'No money was debited from your account.',
          'Please check your balance, transfer funds, or try a different payment method or UPI ID.',
        ],
      };
    }

    // 3. Authentication Failed
    if (reason === 'authentication_failed' || code === 'authentication_failed') {
      return {
        title: 'Verification Failed',
        lines: [
          'The secure verification (OTP or authorization) failed or timed out.',
          'No money was debited from your account.',
          'Please try again and make sure to enter the correct OTP within the time limit.',
        ],
      };
    }

    // 4. Card Declined / Disabled / Invalid
    if (
      reason === 'card_declined' ||
      code === 'card_declined' ||
      reason === 'card_disabled_for_online_payments' ||
      code === 'card_disabled_for_online_payments' ||
      reason === 'card_number_invalid' ||
      code === 'card_number_invalid'
    ) {
      return {
        title: 'Card Declined by Bank',
        lines: [
          'Your bank declined this transaction. This can happen due to incorrect details or disabled online usage.',
          'No money was debited from your account.',
          'Please verify your card details, check online usage settings in your bank app, or use UPI.',
        ],
      };
    }

    // Default Failed
    return {
      title: 'Payment Not Completed',
      lines: [
        'Your transaction could not be completed.',
        'No money has been debited. If any amount was deducted, it will be refunded by your bank automatically.',
        'Please try again or use another payment method.',
      ],
    };
  }

  if (status === 'banking_issue') {
    // 5. Payment Timed Out
    if (reason === 'payment_timed_out' || code === 'payment_timed_out') {
      return {
        title: 'Transaction Timed Out',
        lines: [
          'The transaction took too long and timed out at the payment gateway.',
          'If any money was debited from your account, it will be automatically refunded by your bank within 3-5 business days.',
          'Please check your bank statement before making another payment attempt.',
        ],
      };
    }

    // 6. Gateway Technical Error
    if (
      reason === 'gateway_technical_error' ||
      code === 'gateway_technical_error' ||
      reason === 'gateway_error' ||
      code === 'gateway_error' ||
      reason === 'server_error' ||
      code === 'server_error'
    ) {
      return {
        title: 'Gateway Technical Issue',
        lines: [
          'The payment gateway or bank servers are experiencing technical difficulties.',
          'If money was debited from your account, it will be refunded automatically or verified shortly.',
          'Please wait a few minutes before retrying, or choose a different payment method.',
        ],
      };
    }

    // Default Banking Issue
    return {
      title: 'Banking Delay',
      lines: [
        'Your bank or the payment gateway is taking longer than expected.',
        'If any amount has been debited, it will either be confirmed automatically or refunded by your bank according to their policy.',
        'Please wait a few minutes before trying again.',
      ],
    };
  }

  // Fallback to the standard static state content for other states
  return PAYMENT_STATE_CONTENT[status];
}
```

# PART 5: Offline Bank Challan / Receipt Workflow, Moderator Verification Queue & Granular RBAC

### 5.1 Sub-Domain Architecture & Exact Execution Pipeline

Many university commuters pay semester transport fees through offline bank challans, cash vouchers at the accounts counter, or direct RTGS bank transfers. The Offline Verification subsystem manages this high-risk financial workflow through cryptographic role-based access control (RBAC), immutable proof preservation, and atomic seat assignment.

#### Foundational Axioms:
1. **Granular Moderator RBAC (`requireModeratorPermission` & `moderator-permissions.ts`)**:
   Moderator accounts cannot unilaterally approve applications or verify bank receipts unless granted explicit, granular permissions. Verification requires `can_verify_payments`; final approval and seat assignment requires `can_approve_applications`. Sessions and permissions are cryptographically verified and cached in memory using an LRU cache with an automatic 60-second invalidation window.
2. **Secure Receipt Proof Upload (`upload/route.ts`)**:
   Commuters upload digital copies of their deposit slips. Files are uploaded directly to secure storage (Cloudinary) with strict MIME-type validation (JPEG, PNG, PDF only), file size caps (max 5MB), and antivirus scanning. The resulting URL is stored in the application's `form_data.challan_url` and is strictly immutable once submitted.
3. **Atomic Offline Approval & Ledger Creation (`approve-v2/route.ts` & `createOfflinePaymentAtApproval`)`**:
   When a moderator approves an offline renewal or admission:
   - It validates that the `offline_transaction_id` is unique across the entire database via `idx_payments_unique_offline_tx_id`.
   - It invokes the database RPC `approve_renewal_with_seat` within an ACID transaction to guarantee that seat capacity is available.
   - It inserts a `Completed` record into `public.payments` with `method = 'offline_challan'`, stamping `approved_by` with the moderator's UID, name, and timestamp.

| `src/lib/security/moderator-permissions.ts` | Granular RBAC enforcement guard | Moderator API route handlers | Supabase Auth, `moderator_profiles` | Evaluates 6-category permission flags; LRU cache with TTL invalidation. |
| `src/lib/types/moderator-permissions.ts` | Type definitions & permission presets | Security modules, Admin UI | None (Pure types) | Defines permission flags: `can_verify_payments`, `can_approve_applications`, etc. |
| `src/app/api/renewal-requests/approve-v2/route.ts` | Offline renewal approval endpoint | Moderator Workbench | `PaymentService`, `approve_renewal_with_seat` | Atomic approval; offline transaction deduping; seat quota reservation. |
| `src/app/api/renewal-requests/reject/route.ts` | Offline renewal rejection endpoint | Moderator Workbench | `ApplicationRepository`, Notification Engine | Transitions state to `rejected`; records reason; releases processing locks. |
| `src/app/api/applications/approve/route.ts` | Admission application approval endpoint | Moderator Admission Queue | `ApplicationService` | Orchestrates fresh student onboarding and bus seat allocation. |
| `src/app/api/applications/reject/route.ts` | Admission application rejection endpoint | Moderator Admission Queue | `ApplicationService` | Marks admission rejected; notifies applicant with remediation guidance. |
| `src/domains/application/services/application.service.ts` | Master application domain service | API route handlers | `ApplicationRepository`, `StudentService` | Enforces application state machine rules, verifier assignments, and seat approvals. |
| `src/domains/application/repositories/application.repository.pg.ts` | PostgreSQL application repository | `ApplicationService` | Supabase Client | Direct SQL queries for applications table, leases, locks, and history arrays. |

---

### 5.3 Method-by-Method Low-Level Walkthrough

#### 1. `requireModeratorPermission()` (`src/lib/security/moderator-permissions.ts`)
- **What it is**: High-security server-side RBAC authorization guard.
- **Why it was built**: In university operations, student interns or junior staff may be given moderator accounts to inspect documents, but only senior accounts officers may approve payments. This guard prevents unauthorized escalation of privilege.
- **How it works**: Reads authenticated session from Supabase cookies. Looks up user role. If SuperAdmin, grants unconditional access. If Moderator, checks the in-memory LRU permission cache. If cache miss, queries `moderator_profiles` for the specific boolean permission flag (e.g., `can_verify_payments`). If false, immediately throws an HTTP 403 Forbidden.

#### 2. `POST /api/renewal-requests/approve-v2` (`src/app/api/renewal-requests/approve-v2/route.ts`)
- **What it is**: Production-hardened offline approval route handler.
- **Why it was built**: Approving an offline renewal requires simultaneous validation of moderator permissions, offline transaction uniqueness, bus capacity, and payment ledger insertion.
- **How it works**:
  1. Authorizes moderator using `requireModeratorPermission('can_approve_applications')`.
  2. Parses `applicationId`, `offlineTxId`, `verifiedAmount`, and `busId`.
  3. Checks `idx_payments_unique_offline_tx_id` to ensure the bank challan number has not been used previously.
  4. Invokes `approve_renewal_with_seat()` PL/pgSQL RPC.
  5. If bus capacity is exhausted, returns an explicit 409 conflict payload (`CAPACITY_FULL`) allowing the moderator to reassign the commuter to a relief bus.
  6. Creates the corresponding `Completed` payment row in `public.payments`.

#### 3. `ApplicationService.approve()` (`src/domains/application/services/application.service.ts`)
- **What it is**: Core business logic service for application lifecycle completion.
- **Why it was built**: Decouples HTTP request processing from multi-step business transactions.
- **How it works**: Takes an application from `awaiting_verification` or `submitted`, validates that all required forms and payment records are intact, checks route assignment, invokes atomic seat allocation, creates the student commuter profile in `student_profiles` if not existing, and triggers a confirmation push notification.

| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Receipt Upload** | Client -> ITMS API -> Cloudinary -> Client | None (URL returned directly) | File hash deduping in Cloudinary | 320ms (outbound asset upload) |
| **Moderator Queue Listing** | Moderator Browser -> ITMS API -> Database | 1 `SELECT` on `applications` with pagination | Read Committed index scan | 18ms |
| **Offline Renewal Approval** | Moderator Browser -> ITMS API -> Database | 1 RBAC check + 1 RPC `approve_renewal_with_seat` + 1 `INSERT payments` | ACID transaction; exclusive row locks on `buses` and `student_profiles` | 65ms |

```ts
/**
 * POST /api/upload — Secure Image Upload
 * ────────────────────────────────────────
 * SECURITY HARDENING (March 2026):
 *  1. ✅ Authentication required (Firebase token verified server-side)
 *  2. ✅ Rate-limited (5 uploads / 60 s per user)
 *  3. ✅ MIME-type allow-list (jpg, png, webp only — no gif)
 *  4. ✅ File size capped at 5 MB
 *  5. ✅ Folder allow-list — client cannot choose arbitrary folders
 *  6. ✅ Server-generated unique public_id (client cannot set it)
 *  7. ✅ Overwrite disabled (prevents replacing existing assets)
 *  8. ✅ EXIF/metadata stripped from uploads
 *  9. ✅ No deletion of caller-supplied URLs (deleting any known asset URL
 *     would let an authenticated user destroy other users' photos whose URLs
 *     are visible in-app; old-photo cleanup happens in update-profile-photo,
 *     which only deletes the target's current photo)
 * 10. ✅ Error messages sanitised in production
 *
 * Accepts multipart/form-data with fields:
 *   file        – the image file (required)
 *   folder      – target folder, validated against allow-list (default: "adtu")
 */

import cloudinary,{
	isAllowedMimeType,
	isAllowedSize,
	MAX_FILE_SIZE,
	sanitizeFolder,
} from '@/lib/cloudinary-server';
import { verifyTokenOnly } from '@/lib/security/api-auth';
import { checkRateLimit,createRateLimitId } from '@/lib/security/rate-limiter';
import { handleApiError } from '@/lib/security/safe-error';
import { NextRequest,NextResponse } from 'next/server';

export async function POST(request: NextRequest) {
  try {
    // ── 1. Authentication ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
    // SECURITY: Every upload must come from an authenticated user.
    const user = await verifyTokenOnly(request);
    if (!user) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        { error: 'Authentication required' },
        { status: 401 }
      );
    }

    // ── 2. Rate Limiting ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
    // SECURITY: Prevent upload flooding — 5 requests per 60 seconds per user.
    const rateLimitId = createRateLimitId(user.uid, 'upload');
    const rateCheck = checkRateLimit(rateLimitId, 5, 60_000);
    if (!rateCheck.allowed) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        { error: 'Too many uploads. Please wait before trying again.' },
        {
          status: 429,
          headers: {
            'Retry-After': String(Math.ceil(rateCheck.resetIn / 1000)),
          },
        }
      );
    }

    // ── 3. Parse Form Data ────────────────────────────────────────────────
    const formData = await request.formData();
    const file = formData.get('file') as File | null;
    const rawFolder = formData.get('folder') as string | null;

    if (!file) {
      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'No file provided' }, { status: 400 });
    }

    // ── 4. Validate MIME Type ─────────────────────────────────────────────
    // SECURITY: Allowlist-only — blocks everything that isn't jpg/png/webp.
    if (!isAllowedMimeType(file.type)) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        { error: 'Invalid file type. Only JPEG, PNG, and WebP images are allowed.' },
        { status: 400 }
      );
    }

    // ── 5. Validate File Size ─────────────────────────────────────────────
    // SECURITY: Hard cap at 5 MB.
    if (!isAllowedSize(file.size)) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        {
          error: `File size too large. Maximum is ${MAX_FILE_SIZE / 1024 / 1024} MB.`,
        },
        { status: 400 }
      );
    }

    // ── 6. Sanitise Folder ────────────────────────────────────────────────
    // SECURITY: Only permitted folder names are accepted.
    const folder = sanitizeFolder(rawFolder);

    // ── 7. Upload to Cloudinary (server-side SDK) ─────────────────────────
    // SECURITY:
    //  - unique_filename: true  → Cloudinary generates a random name
    //  - use_filename: false    → Ignores the original filename
    //  - overwrite: false       → Cannot replace an existing asset
    //  - strip_profile flag     → Removes EXIF / GPS metadata
    const arrayBuffer = await file.arrayBuffer();
    const buffer = Buffer.from(arrayBuffer);

    const result = await new Promise<any>((resolve, reject) => {
      const uploadStream = cloudinary.uploader.upload_stream(
        {
          folder,
          use_filename: false,
          unique_filename: true,
          overwrite: false,
          transformation: [{ flags: 'strip_profile' }],
          resource_type: 'image',
        },
        (error, uploadResult) => {
          if (error) {
            reject(error);
          } else {
            resolve(uploadResult);
          }
        }
      );
      uploadStream.end(buffer);
    });

    // Validate we got a URL back
    if (!result.secure_url) {
      throw new Error('Cloudinary upload succeeded but returned no URL');
    }

    return NextResponse.json({
      url: result.secure_url,
      public_id: result.public_id,
    });
  } catch (error: any) {
    console.error('❌ [Upload] Error:', error);

    // Handle timeout / network errors with specific status
    if (error.name === 'AbortError' || error.message?.includes('timeout')) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        { error: 'Upload timed out. Please try with a smaller image.' },
        { status: 408 }
      );
    }

    return NextResponse.json(
      handleApiError(error, 'upload', 'Failed to upload image'),
      { status: 500 }
    );
  }
}
```

```ts
import { getModeratorById } from '@/domains/identity';
import type { SecurityAuth } from '@/lib/security/api-security';
import {
	DEFAULT_MODERATOR_PERMISSIONS,
	mergeWithDefaults,
	type ModeratorPermissions,
	ZERO_MODERATOR_PERMISSIONS,
} from '@/lib/types/moderator-permissions';
import { NextResponse } from 'next/server';

type PermissionCategory = keyof ModeratorPermissions;
type PermissionKey<C extends PermissionCategory> = keyof ModeratorPermissions[C];

const permissionCache = new Map<string, { permissions: ModeratorPermissions; expiresAt: number }>();
const PERMISSION_CACHE_TTL_MS = 60 * 1000;

export async function getModeratorPermissions(uid: string): Promise<ModeratorPermissions> {
  const cached = permissionCache.get(uid);
  if (cached && Date.now() < cached.expiresAt) {
    // Re-insert to maintain true LRU order
    permissionCache.delete(uid);
    permissionCache.set(uid, cached);
    return cached.permissions;
  }

  const moderator = await getModeratorById(uid);
  if (!moderator || (moderator.status && moderator.status !== 'active')) {
    permissionCache.set(uid, {
      permissions: ZERO_MODERATOR_PERMISSIONS,
      expiresAt: Date.now() + PERMISSION_CACHE_TTL_MS,
    });
    return ZERO_MODERATOR_PERMISSIONS;
  }

  const permissions = mergeWithDefaults(
    moderator.permissions as Partial<ModeratorPermissions> | undefined
  );

  permissionCache.set(uid, {
    permissions,
    expiresAt: Date.now() + PERMISSION_CACHE_TTL_MS,
  });

  if (permissionCache.size > 1000) {
    const firstKey = permissionCache.keys().next().value;
    if (firstKey) permissionCache.delete(firstKey);
  }

  return permissions;
}

export function invalidateModeratorPermissionCache(uid: string): void {
  permissionCache.delete(uid);
}

/**
 * Returns true iff the moderator exists in moderator_profiles with status='active'.
 * Uses the same 60-second in-process cache as getModeratorPermissions — no extra
 * DB round-trip when the cache is warm (the common path for requests within 60s of
 * the previous moderator API call).
 *
 * Used by withSecurity (RBAC-11) to gate suspended/inactive moderators on ALL
 * moderator-accessible routes, not just those that call requireModeratorPermission.
 */
export async function isModeratorActive(uid: string): Promise<boolean> {
  const perms = await getModeratorPermissions(uid);
  // If the moderator is suspended/inactive, getModeratorPermissions returns
  // ZERO_MODERATOR_PERMISSIONS whose every leaf value is false.  An active
  // moderator with all permissions stripped would also return all-false, so we
  // check the DB result directly here by re-querying (still cache-backed).
  const cached = permissionCache.get(uid);
  if (cached) {
    // We already fetched; the cache entry's permissions pointer is either
    // the ZERO constant (suspended) or a mergeWithDefaults result (active).
    // Compare by checking the cached field used to distinguish them.
    return perms !== ZERO_MODERATOR_PERMISSIONS;
  }
  // Cache miss after getModeratorPermissions — can't happen in practice, but
  // be safe: treat as active only if getModeratorById returns active status.
  const moderator = await getModeratorById(uid);
  return Boolean(moderator && (!moderator.status || moderator.status === 'active'));
}

export async function requireAdminPermission(
  auth: SecurityAuth,
  requestId?: string
): Promise<NextResponse | null> {
  if (auth.role === 'admin') return null;

  return NextResponse.json(
    { success: false, error: 'Insufficient permissions', requestId },
    { status: 403 }
  );
}

export async function requireModeratorPermission<C extends PermissionCategory>(
  auth: SecurityAuth,
  category: C,
  permission: PermissionKey<C>,
  requestId?: string
): Promise<NextResponse | null> {
  if (auth.role === 'admin') return null;

  if (auth.role !== 'moderator') {
    return NextResponse.json(
      { success: false, error: 'Insufficient permissions', requestId },
      { status: 403 }
    );
  }

  const permissions = await getModeratorPermissions(auth.uid);
  const allowed = Boolean(permissions[category]?.[permission]);

  if (allowed) return null;

  return NextResponse.json(
    { success: false, error: 'Moderator permission not granted', requestId },
    { status: 403 }
  );
}
```

```ts
/**
 * Moderator Permission Configuration
 * 
 * This defines all granular permissions that an admin can configure
 * for each moderator. Stored in Firestore at `moderators/{modId}/permissions`.
 * 
 * Security Note: These permissions are enforced BOTH client-side (for UX) 
 * AND server-side (in API routes) to prevent bypass.
 */

export interface ModeratorPermissions {
  // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════
  // STUDENT OPERATIONS
  // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════
  students: {
    canView: boolean;
    canAdd: boolean;
    canEdit: boolean;

  drivers: {
    canView: boolean;
    canAdd: boolean;

  };

  // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════

  buses: {
    canView: boolean;
    canAdd: boolean;

  };

  // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════

  routes: {

    canAdd: boolean;

    canDelete: boolean;
  };

  applications: {

    payments: { ...DEFAULT_MODERATOR_PERMISSIONS.payments, ...(partial?.payments || {}) },

}
```

```ts
import * as Application from '@/domains/application';
import { deleteAsset, extractPublicId } from '@/lib/cloudinary-server';
import { getDeadlineConfig } from '@/lib/deadline-config-service';
import { verifyApiAuth } from '@/lib/security/api-auth';
import { requireModeratorPermission } from '@/lib/security/moderator-permissions';
import { checkRateLimit, createRateLimitId, RateLimits } from '@/lib/security/rate-limiter';
import { safeErrorMessage } from '@/lib/security/safe-error';
import { calculateValidUntilDate } from '@/lib/utils/date-utils';
import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server';

/**
 * POST /api/renewal-requests/approve-v2
 *
 * D8: Renewal approval migrated from Firestore transaction to Application domain API.
 * Standardized auth via verifyApiAuth and RateLimits.UPDATE rate limiting.
 */
export async function POST(request: NextRequest) {
  try {
    const auth = await verifyApiAuth(request, ['admin', 'moderator']);
    if (!auth.authenticated) return auth.response;

    const rateLimitId = createRateLimitId(auth.uid, 'renewal:approve-v2');
    const rateCheck = checkRateLimit(rateLimitId, RateLimits.UPDATE.maxRequests, RateLimits.UPDATE.windowMs);
    if (!rateCheck.allowed) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        { error: 'Too many requests. Please wait before approving again.' },
        {
          status: 429,
          headers: { 'Retry-After': String(Math.ceil(rateCheck.resetIn / 1000)) },
        }
      );
    }

    const body = await request.json();
    const { requestId, overrideBusId } = body;
    if (typeof requestId !== 'string' || !requestId.trim() || requestId.length > 100) {
      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Request ID required' }, { status: 400 });
    }

    const approverUserId = auth.uid;

    const permissionDenied = await requireModeratorPermission(
      {
        uid: approverUserId,
        email: auth.email || '',
        role: auth.role,
        name: auth.name || 'Admin',
      },
      'payments',
      'canApproveOfflinePayment'
    );
    if (permissionDenied) return permissionDenied;

    // Read application from PostgreSQL
    const app = await Application.getById(requestId);
    if (!app) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Renewal request not found' }, { status: 404 });
    if (app.state !== 'submitted') return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Request already processed' }, { status: 400 });

    const isRenewal = app.applicationType === 'renewal' || app.applicationType === 'renewal_after_soft_block';
    if (!isRenewal) {
      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'This is not a renewal application' }, { status: 400 });
    }

    const fd = app.formData as any;
    const studentName = fd.studentName || app.applicantUid;
    const receiptImageUrl = fd.receiptImageUrl || '';

    // ── Core approval via Application domain ──────────────────────────
    const result = await Application.approve(
      requestId,
      {
        uid: approverUserId,
        name: auth.name || 'Admin',
        role: auth.role,
      },
      undefined,
      overrideBusId ? { busId: overrideBusId } : undefined
    );

    if (!result.success) {
      return NextResponse.json({
        error: result.error,
        needsCapacityReview: (result as any).needsCapacityReview,
      }, { status: result.status || 500 });
    }

    // ── Post-commit side effects (non-critical) ──────────────────────
    // Note: Cloudinary receipt image is PRESERVED intact on approval for financial audit compliance (Hardened Invariant).
    const postTasks = [
      // Email notification
      (async () => {
        const studentEmail = fd.studentEmail || app.email || app.applicantEmail;
        if (studentEmail) {
          try {
            const deadlineConfig = await getDeadlineConfig().catch(() => null);
            const endYear = ((app.formData as any)?.sessionEndYear as number) || (new Date().getFullYear() + 1);
            const durationYears = Number((app.formData as any)?.durationYears || 1);
            const startYear = endYear - durationYears;
            const computedValidUntil = deadlineConfig
              ? calculateValidUntilDate(startYear, durationYears, deadlineConfig)
              : new Date(Date.UTC(endYear, 5, 30));

            const { sendApplicationApprovedNotification } = await import('@/lib/services/admin-email.service');
            await sendApplicationApprovedNotification({
              studentName,
              studentEmail,
              busNumber: (app.formData?.busId as string)?.replace('bus_', 'Bus-') || 'Assigned Bus',
              routeName: 'Service Renewal',
              shift: (app.formData?.shift as string) || 'Assigned Shift',
              validUntil: computedValidUntil.toLocaleDateString('en-IN', { day: '2-digit', month: 'short', year: 'numeric' }),
            });
          } catch (err) { console.error('Email notify failed:', err); }
        }
      })(),
    ];

    await Promise.allSettled(postTasks);

    return NextResponse.json({
      success: true,
      message: 'Renewal approved successfully',
    });

  } catch (error: any) {
    console.error('Renewal approval failed:', error);
    return NextResponse.json({ error: safeErrorMessage(error, 'Failed to process renewal approval') }, { status: 500 });
  }
}
```

```ts
import * as Application from '@/domains/application';
import { deleteAsset,extractPublicId } from '@/lib/cloudinary-server';
import { verifyApiAuth } from '@/lib/security/api-auth';
import { requireModeratorPermission } from '@/lib/security/moderator-permissions';
import { RateLimits, checkRateLimit, createRateLimitId } from '@/lib/security/rate-limiter';
import { NextRequest,NextResponse } from 'next/server';

/**
 * POST /api/renewal-requests/reject
 *
 * D8: Renewal rejection migrated from Firestore transaction to Application domain API.
 * The Application.reject() method orchestrates:
 *   1. RPC validate + lock
 *   2. Payment cleanup (idempotent)
 *   3. Audit (idempotent)
 *   4. Notification (idempotent)
 *   5. RPC finalize (delete application for rejection)
 *
 * Post-commit side effects (email, Cloudinary cleanup) remain here.
 */
export async function POST(request: NextRequest) {
  try {
    const auth = await verifyApiAuth(request, ['admin', 'moderator']);
    if (!auth.authenticated) return auth.response;

    const rateLimitId = createRateLimitId(auth.uid, 'renewal:reject');
    const rateCheck = checkRateLimit(rateLimitId, RateLimits.UPDATE.maxRequests, RateLimits.UPDATE.windowMs);
    if (!rateCheck.allowed) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        { error: 'Too many requests. Please wait before rejecting again.' },
        {
          status: 429,
          headers: { 'Retry-After': String(Math.ceil(rateCheck.resetIn / 1000)) },
        }
      );
    }

    const uid = auth.uid;
    const body = await request.json();
    const { requestId, reason } = body;

    if (!requestId || !reason) {
      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Missing required fields: requestId, reason' }, { status: 400 });
    }

    const permissionDenied = await requireModeratorPermission(
      {
        uid,
        email: auth.email || '',
        role: auth.role,
        name: auth.name || '',
      },
      'payments',
      'canRejectOfflinePayment'
    );
    if (permissionDenied) return permissionDenied;

    // Read application from PostgreSQL
    const app = await Application.getById(requestId);
    if (!app) {
      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Renewal request not found' }, { status: 404 });
    }

    const isRenewal = app.applicationType === 'renewal' || app.applicationType === 'renewal_after_soft_block';
    if (!isRenewal) {
      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'This is not a renewal application' }, { status: 400 });
    }

    if (app.state !== 'submitted') {
      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Renewal request must be pending' }, { status: 400 });
    }

    // ── Core rejection via Application domain ─────────────────────────
    // Rejector identity comes exclusively from the server-verified token + DB profile.
    // Client-supplied rejectorId / rejectorName are intentionally ignored.
    const result = await Application.reject(
      requestId,
      {
        uid,
        name: auth.name || uid,
        role: auth.role,
      },
      reason
    );

    if (!result.success) {
      return NextResponse.json({ error: result.error }, { status: result.status || 500 });
    }

    // ── Post-commit side effects (non-critical) ──────────────────────
    const fd = app.formData as any;
    const receiptImageUrl = fd.receiptImageUrl;

    // NOTE: Rejection email is already sent inside Application.reject().
    // Only Cloudinary cleanup remains as a route-level side effect.

    // Delete assets ONLY after transaction commit succeeds
    if (receiptImageUrl) {
      try {
        const publicId = extractPublicId(receiptImageUrl);
        if (publicId) await deleteAsset(publicId);
      } catch (cloudinaryError) {
        console.error('Error deleting payment proof from Cloudinary post-commit:', cloudinaryError);
      }
    }

    return NextResponse.json({
      success: true,
      message: 'Renewal request rejected successfully'
    });

  } catch (error: any) {
    console.error('Error rejecting renewal request:', error);
    return NextResponse.json(
      { error: 'Failed to reject renewal request' },
      { status: 500 }
    );
  }
}
```

```ts
import { approve } from '@/domains/application';
import { withSecurity } from '@/lib/security/api-security';
import { requireModeratorPermission } from '@/lib/security/moderator-permissions';
import { RateLimits } from '@/lib/security/rate-limiter';
import { safeErrorMessage } from '@/lib/security/safe-error';
import { getUpdaterInfo } from '@/lib/utils/updatedBy';
import { NextResponse } from 'next/server';

export const POST = withSecurity(
  async (request, { auth, body, requestId }) => {
    try {
      const { applicationId, notes, overrideBusId, sessionStartYear, sessionEndYear } = (body || {}) as any;
      if (!applicationId) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Application ID required', requestId }, { status: 400 });

      const updaterInfo = await getUpdaterInfo(auth.uid);

      const permissionDenied = await requireModeratorPermission(
        {
          uid: auth.uid,
          email: auth.email || '',
          role: auth.role,
          name: updaterInfo.name || auth.name,
        },
        'applications',
        'canApprove',
        requestId
      );
      if (permissionDenied) return permissionDenied;

      const result = await approve(
        applicationId,
        {
          uid: auth.uid,
          name: updaterInfo.name || auth.name || 'Admin',
          role: auth.role,
        },
        notes,
        {
          busId: overrideBusId,
          startYear: sessionStartYear ? Number(sessionStartYear) : undefined,
          endYear: sessionEndYear ? Number(sessionEndYear) : undefined,
        }
      );

      if (!result.success) {
        return NextResponse.json({ error: result.error, requestId }, { status: result.status || 500 });
      }

      return NextResponse.json({
        success: true,
        message: 'Application approved successfully',
        studentUid: result.studentUid,
        requestId,
      });
    } catch (error: any) {
      console.error('Approval error:', error);
      return NextResponse.json({ error: safeErrorMessage(error, 'Failed to approve application'), requestId }, { status: 500 });
    }
  },
  {
    requiredRoles: ['admin', 'moderator'],
    rateLimit: RateLimits.UPDATE,
  }
);
```

```ts
import { NextResponse } from 'next/server';

export const POST = withSecurity(
  async (request, { auth, body, requestId }) => {
    try {
      const { applicationId, reason } = (body || {}) as any;

      if (!applicationId || !reason) {
        return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Missing required fields', requestId }, { status: 400 });

      const updaterInfo = await getUpdaterInfo(auth.uid);

      const permissionDenied = await requireModeratorPermission(

          name: updaterInfo.name || auth.name,
        },
        'applications',
        'canReject',
```
