import { getByApplicantUid } from '@/domains/application';
import { getUserByEmail, getUserById, getUsersByEmails, getUsersByIds } from '@/domains/identity';
import { getByUid as getStudentByUid } from '@/domains/student';
import { getAllPayments, getPaymentsByStudent } from '@/lib/payment/payment.service';
import { withSecurity } from '@/lib/security/api-security';
import { RateLimits } from '@/lib/security/rate-limiter';
import { NextResponse } from 'next/server';

export const GET = withSecurity(
  async (request, { auth }) => {
    try {
      const userId = auth.uid;
      const userRole = auth.role;

      const { searchParams } = new URL(request.url);
      const studentId = searchParams.get('studentId');
      const studentUid = searchParams.get('studentUid');
      const year = searchParams.get('year');
      const page = parseInt(searchParams.get('page') || '1');
      const limit = parseInt(searchParams.get('limit') || '50');
      const paymentMethod = (searchParams.get('paymentMethod') || searchParams.get('method')) as 'Online' | 'Offline' | null;
      const statusParam = searchParams.get('status');
      const VALID_STATUS_MAP: Record<string, string> = {
        completed: 'Completed',
        pending: 'Pending',
        rejected: 'Rejected',
        duplicate_pending_refund: 'Duplicate_Pending_Refund',
        captured_pending_review: 'Captured_Pending_Review',
        refunded: 'Refunded',
        refund_denied: 'Refund_Denied',
      };

      let statusFilter: string | undefined = undefined;
      if (statusParam && statusParam !== 'all') {
        const canonical = VALID_STATUS_MAP[statusParam.toLowerCase()];
        if (!canonical) {
          return NextResponse.json(
            { error: `Invalid status parameter '${statusParam}'. Allowed: all, Completed, Pending, Rejected, Duplicate_Pending_Refund, Captured_Pending_Review, Refunded, Refund_Denied` },
            { status: 400 }
          );
        }
        statusFilter = canonical;
      }

      // Helper to map Firestore documents to frontend-expected format
      const userCache = new Map<string, string>(); // Request-scope cache for user lookups

      const prefetchApprovers = async (paymentsList: any[]) => {
        const userIdsToFetch = new Set<string>();
        const emailsToFetch = new Set<string>();

        for (const p of paymentsList) {
          const approver = p?.approvedBy || p?.approved_by;
          if (approver) {
            if (typeof approver === 'object') {
              if (['Manual', 'admin', 'moderator'].includes(approver.type)) {
                if (approver.userId && !userCache.has(approver.userId)) {
                  userIdsToFetch.add(approver.userId);
                } else if (approver.name && approver.name.includes('@') && !userCache.has(approver.name)) {
                  emailsToFetch.add(approver.name);
                }
              }
            } else {
              const strValue = String(approver);
              const emailMatch = strValue.match(/^(.+?) \((.+?)\)$/);
              if (emailMatch && emailMatch[1].includes('@') && !userCache.has(emailMatch[1])) {
                emailsToFetch.add(emailMatch[1]);
              }
            }
          }
        }

        if (userIdsToFetch.size === 0 && emailsToFetch.size === 0) return;

        try {
          const [usersById, usersByEmail] = await Promise.all([
            userIdsToFetch.size > 0 ? getUsersByIds(Array.from(userIdsToFetch)) : Promise.resolve([]),
            emailsToFetch.size > 0 ? getUsersByEmails(Array.from(emailsToFetch)) : Promise.resolve([]),
          ]);

          for (const user of usersById) {
            if (user?.uid) {
              userCache.set(user.uid, (user as any).fullName || (user as any).name || user.uid);
            }
          }
          for (const user of usersByEmail) {
            if (user?.email) {
              userCache.set(user.email, (user as any).fullName || (user as any).name || user.email);
            }
          }
        } catch (e) {
          console.warn('Failed to pre-fetch approvers in batch', e);
        }
      };

      const mapToFrontend = async (p: any) => {
        if (!p) return null;

        // Helper to resolve name from user ID or email
        const resolveName = async (uid: string | undefined, emailOrName: string) => {
          if (!emailOrName || !emailOrName.includes('@')) return emailOrName;

          const cacheKey = uid || emailOrName;
          if (userCache.has(cacheKey)) return userCache.get(cacheKey)!;

          try {
            let resolvedUser = null;
            if (uid) {
              resolvedUser = await getUserById(uid);
            }

            if (!resolvedUser && emailOrName.includes('@')) {
              resolvedUser = await getUserByEmail(emailOrName);
            }

            if (resolvedUser) {
              const resolvedName = (resolvedUser as any).fullName || (resolvedUser as any).name || emailOrName;
              userCache.set(cacheKey, resolvedName);
              return resolvedName;
            }
          } catch (e) {
            console.warn('Failed to resolve user name for payment', e);
          }
          return emailOrName;
        };

        // Map approvedBy object to string if it exists
        let approvedByStr = undefined;
        const approver = p?.approvedBy || p?.approved_by;
        if (approver) {
          if (typeof approver === 'object') {
            if (['Manual', 'admin', 'moderator'].includes(approver.type)) {
              const name = await resolveName(approver.userId, approver.name);
              const role = approver.role || approver.type || 'moderator';
              const suffix = role.toLowerCase() === 'admin' ? '(ADMIN)' : `(${approver.empId || 'STAFF'})`;
              approvedByStr = `${name} ${suffix}`;
            } else if (approver.type === 'SYSTEM') {
              approvedByStr = 'System-Approved';
            }
          } else {
            const strValue = String(approver);
            approvedByStr = (strValue === 'AdtU ITMS System' || strValue === 'System Verified') ? 'System-Approved' : strValue;

            const emailMatch = strValue.match(/^(.+?) \((.+?)\)$/);
            if (emailMatch) {
              const email = emailMatch[1];
              const idPart = emailMatch[2];

              if (email.includes('@')) {
                const name = await resolveName(undefined, email);
                if (name !== email) {
                  approvedByStr = `${name} (${idPart})`;
                }
              }
            }
          }
        }

        const getTimestamp = (val: any) => {
          if (!val) return new Date().toISOString();
          if (typeof val.toDate === 'function') return val.toDate().toISOString();
          if (val instanceof Date) return val.toISOString();
          if (typeof val === 'string') return val;
          return new Date().toISOString();
        };

        const rawStatus = p.status || 'Completed';
        const normalizedStatus = (rawStatus.toLowerCase() === 'duplicate_pending_refund' || rawStatus === 'Duplicate_Pending_Refund')
          ? 'Duplicate_Pending_Refund'
          : rawStatus;

        return {
          ...p,
          paymentMethod: p.method?.toLowerCase() || 'online',
          status: normalizedStatus,
          approvedBy: approvedByStr || (p.method?.toLowerCase() === 'online' ? 'System-Approved' : '-'),
          timestamp: getTimestamp(p.createdAt || p.timestamp),
          validUntil: p.validUntil ? getTimestamp(p.validUntil) : 'N/A'
        };
      };

      // For students, they can only view their own transactions
      if (userRole === 'student') {
        let enrollmentId: string | undefined;

        try {
          const student = await getStudentByUid(userId);
          if (student) {
            enrollmentId = (student as any).enrollmentId;
          }
        } catch (e) {
          console.warn('Failed to fetch student profile for enrollment ID', e);
        }

        const { payments, total } = await getPaymentsByStudent(userId, enrollmentId, page, limit);
        await prefetchApprovers(payments);

        const pendingRenewalApp = await getByApplicantUid(userId);

        let pendingRequests: any[] = [];
        if (
          pendingRenewalApp &&
          pendingRenewalApp.state === 'submitted' &&
          (pendingRenewalApp.applicationType === 'renewal' || pendingRenewalApp.applicationType === 'renewal_after_soft_block')
        ) {
          const formAny = (pendingRenewalApp.formData || {}) as any;
          const targetSession = pendingRenewalApp.targetSession;
          const sessionLabel = targetSession
            ? (typeof targetSession === 'object' && 'startYear' in targetSession
                ? `${targetSession.startYear}-${targetSession.endYear}`
                : String(targetSession))
            : 'Upcoming Session';

          pendingRequests = [{
            id: pendingRenewalApp.applicationId,
            amount: formAny.paymentDetails?.amount || formAny.paymentInfo?.amountPaid || formAny.paymentInfo?.amount || 0,
            paymentMethod: 'offline',
            status: 'pending',
            timestamp: pendingRenewalApp.createdAt,
            validUntil: 'Pending Approval',
            approvedBy: 'Pending Verification',
            academicSession: sessionLabel,
            receiptImageUrl: formAny.paymentDetails?.receiptImageUrl || formAny.paymentInfo?.paymentEvidenceUrl,
            offlineTransactionId: formAny.paymentDetails?.transactionId || formAny.paymentInfo?.paymentReference,
            type: 'Renewal Application'
          }];
        }

        const transactions = [
          ...pendingRequests,
          ...(await Promise.all(payments.map(mapToFrontend)))
        ];

        return NextResponse.json({
          success: true,
          transactions,
          total: total + pendingRequests.length,
          page,
          limit
        });
      }

      // For admin/moderator, allow viewing all transactions with filters
      if (['admin', 'moderator'].includes(userRole)) {
        const result = await getAllPayments(
          {
            year: year ? parseInt(year) : undefined,
            studentId: studentId || undefined,
            studentUid: studentUid || undefined,
            method: paymentMethod || undefined,
            status: statusFilter as any
          },
          page,
          limit
        );

        await prefetchApprovers(result.payments);

        return NextResponse.json({
          success: true,
          transactions: await Promise.all(result.payments.map(mapToFrontend)),
          total: result.total,
          page: result.page,
          totalPages: result.totalPages
        });
      }

      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Insufficient permissions' }, { status: 403 });

    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error fetching transactions:', error);
      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Internal server error' }, { status: 500 });
    }
  },
  {
    requiredRoles: ['admin', 'moderator', 'student'],
    rateLimit: RateLimits.READ,
  }
);

/**
 * Payment Details API Route
 * 
 * GET /api/payments/[paymentId]
 * Returns detailed payment information for the modal view.
 * 
 * Authentication: Required (Admin, Moderator, or owning Student)
 */

import { getUserById } from '@/domains/identity';
import { verifyToken } from '@/lib/firebase-admin';
import { getPaymentDetails } from '@/lib/payment/payment.service';
import { NextRequest,NextResponse } from 'next/server';

export async function GET(
    request: NextRequest,
    { params }: { params: Promise<{ paymentId: string }> }
) {
    try {
        // Verify authentication
        const token = request.headers.get('Authorization')?.replace('Bearer ', '');
        if (!token) {
            return NextResponse.json(
                { success: false, error: 'Unauthorized' },
                { status: 401 }
            );
        }

        let decodedToken;
        try {
            decodedToken = await verifyToken(token);
        } catch {
            return NextResponse.json(
                { success: false, error: 'Invalid or expired authentication token' },
                { status: 401 }
            );
        }
        const userId = decodedToken.uid;

        // Get user data via Identity domain API
        const user = await getUserById(userId);
        const userData = user as any;

        if (!userData) {
            return NextResponse.json(
                { success: false, error: 'User not found' },
                { status: 404 }
            );
        }

        const { paymentId } = await params;

        if (!paymentId) {
            return NextResponse.json(
                { success: false, error: 'Payment ID is required' },
                { status: 400 }
            );
        }

        // Fetch payment details
        const details = await getPaymentDetails(paymentId);

        if (!details) {
            return NextResponse.json(
                { success: false, error: 'Payment not found' },
                { status: 404 }
            );
        }

        // Authorization check: Only Admin, Moderator, or the owning Student can view payment details
        if (userData.role !== 'admin' && userData.role !== 'moderator') {
            if (userData.role !== 'student' || details.studentUid !== userId) {
                return NextResponse.json(
                    { success: false, error: 'Access denied' },
                    { status: 403 }
                );
            }
        }

        // Serialize dates to ISO strings for JSON response
        const serializedDetails = {
            ...details,
            validUntil: details.validUntil.toISOString(),
            createdAt: details.createdAt.toISOString(),
            updatedAt: details.updatedAt.toISOString(),
            approver: details.approver ? {
                ...details.approver,
                approvedAt: details.approver.approvedAt.toISOString()
            } : undefined
        };

        return NextResponse.json({
            success: true,
            data: serializedDetails
        });

    } catch (error) {
        console.error('Error fetching payment details:', error);
        return NextResponse.json(
            {
                success: false,
                error: 'Failed to fetch payment details'
            },
            { status: 500 }
        );
    }
}

import { reconcileUnresolvedCapture, confirmManualRefund, denyManualRefund } from '@/lib/payment/payment.service';
import { withSecurity } from '@/lib/security/api-security';
import { RateLimits } from '@/lib/security/rate-limiter';
import { NextResponse } from 'next/server';
import { z } from 'zod';

const ReconcilePaymentSchema = z.object({
  action: z.enum(['reconcile', 'confirm_refund', 'deny_refund']).default('reconcile'),
  paymentId: z.string().min(1, 'Payment ID is required'),
  // Fields for action: 'reconcile'
  sessionStartYear: z.number().int().min(2000).max(2100).optional(),
  sessionEndYear: z.number().int().min(2001).max(2101).optional(),
  evidence: z.string().min(5, 'Reconciliation evidence must be at least 5 characters').max(1000).optional(),
  // Fields for action: 'confirm_refund'
  refundReference: z.string().min(3).optional(),
  refundedAmount: z.number().positive().optional(),
  // Fields for action: 'deny_refund'
  reason: z.string().min(5).max(1000).optional(),
});

/**
 * Administrative Payment Reconciliation & Refund State Machine API
 *
 * Operational Governance:
 * 1. Requires verified administrator role.
 * 2. Controlled transition of Captured_Pending_Review to Completed.
 * 3. Controlled transition of Duplicate_Pending_Refund / Captured_Pending_Review to Refunded or Refund_Denied.
 * 4. All transitions enforce durable database persistence before activating entitlements or completing.
 */
export const POST = withSecurity(
  async (request, { auth, body }) => {
    try {
      const { action, paymentId } = body;

      if (action === 'reconcile') {
        if (!body.sessionStartYear || !body.sessionEndYear) {
          return NextResponse.json(
            { error: 'sessionStartYear and sessionEndYear are required for reconciliation.' },
            { status: 400 }
          );
        }
        if (body.sessionStartYear >= body.sessionEndYear) {
          return NextResponse.json(
            { error: 'sessionStartYear must be strictly less than sessionEndYear.' },
            { status: 400 }
          );
        }
        if (!body.evidence || !body.evidence.trim()) {
          return NextResponse.json(
            { error: 'Explicit audit evidence is required for reconciliation.' },
            { status: 400 }
          );
        }

        const result = await reconcileUnresolvedCapture({
          paymentId,
          sessionStartYear: body.sessionStartYear,
          sessionEndYear: body.sessionEndYear,
          reconcilerUserId: auth.uid,
          reconcilerName: auth.name || auth.email || 'Admin',
          reconcilerRole: auth.role,
          evidence: body.evidence.trim(),
        });

        if (!result.success) {
          return NextResponse.json({ error: result.error }, { status: 400 });
        }

        return NextResponse.json({
          success: true,
          action: 'reconcile',
          payment: result.payment,
          message: `Payment ${paymentId} successfully reconciled to Completed for session ${body.sessionStartYear}–${body.sessionEndYear}.`,
        });
      }

      if (action === 'confirm_refund') {
        if (!body.refundReference || !body.refundReference.trim()) {
          return NextResponse.json(
            { error: 'External refund reference (e.g. Razorpay refund ID or bank UTR) is required.' },
            { status: 400 }
          );
        }
        if (!body.refundedAmount || body.refundedAmount <= 0) {
          return NextResponse.json(
            { error: 'Valid refunded amount is required.' },
            { status: 400 }
          );
        }

        const result = await confirmManualRefund({
          paymentId,
          refundReference: body.refundReference.trim(),
          refundedAmount: body.refundedAmount,
          authorizerUserId: auth.uid,
          authorizerName: auth.name || auth.email || 'Admin',
          authorizerRole: auth.role,
          empId: (auth as any).empId,
          reason: body.reason?.trim() || 'Manual refund confirmed by university finance officer',
        });

        if (!result.success) {
          return NextResponse.json({ error: result.error }, { status: 400 });
        }

        return NextResponse.json({
          success: true,
          action: 'confirm_refund',
          isPartial: result.isPartial,
          cumulativeRefunded: result.cumulativeRefunded,
          message: result.isPartial
            ? `Partial refund of Rs. ${body.refundedAmount} recorded for payment ${paymentId} (Cumulative: Rs. ${result.cumulativeRefunded}, Reference: ${body.refundReference}). Payment remains in review until fully refunded.`
            : `Payment ${paymentId} confirmed as Refunded with reference ${body.refundReference}.`,
        });
      }

      if (action === 'deny_refund') {
        if (!body.reason || !body.reason.trim()) {
          return NextResponse.json(
            { error: 'Explicit reason is required to deny refund request.' },
            { status: 400 }
          );
        }

        const result = await denyManualRefund({
          paymentId,
          denierUserId: auth.uid,
          denierName: auth.name || auth.email || 'Admin',
          denierRole: auth.role,
          reason: body.reason.trim(),
        });

        if (!result.success) {
          return NextResponse.json({ error: result.error }, { status: 400 });
        }

        return NextResponse.json({
          success: true,
          action: 'deny_refund',
          message: `Refund for payment ${paymentId} denied. Amount retained in university accounts as Refund_Denied.`,
        });
      }

      return NextResponse.json({ error: `Unsupported action: ${action}` }, { status: 400 });
    } catch (err: any) {
      console.error('[AdminPaymentReconcileAPI] Error:', err);
      return NextResponse.json(
        { error: err?.message || 'Internal error processing payment reconciliation' },
        { status: 500 }
      );
    }
  },
  {
    requiredRoles: ['admin'],
    rateLimit: RateLimits.ADMIN,
    schema: ReconcilePaymentSchema,
  }
);

import { withSecurity } from '@/lib/security/api-security';
import { RateLimits } from '@/lib/security/rate-limiter';
import { EmptySchema } from '@/lib/security/validation-schemas';
import { paymentsSupabaseService } from '@/lib/services/payments-supabase';
import { NextResponse } from 'next/server';

export const GET = withSecurity(
    async () => {
        // Get monthly date boundaries for current year
        const now = new Date();
        const startOfYear = new Date(now.getFullYear(), 0, 1);
        const endOfYear = new Date(now.getFullYear(), 11, 31, 23, 59, 59);

        // Fetch Payment Stats and Year Payments concurrently
        const [stats, yearPayments] = await Promise.all([
            paymentsSupabaseService.getPaymentStats(),
            paymentsSupabaseService.getCompletedPaymentsForReporting(startOfYear, endOfYear),
        ]);

        // Aggregate monthly data in a single O(N) pass
        const months = ['Jan', 'Feb', 'Mar', 'Apr', 'May', 'Jun', 'Jul', 'Aug', 'Sep', 'Oct', 'Nov', 'Dec'];
        const monthlyTotals = new Float64Array(12);
        for (const p of yearPayments) {
            const dateStr = p.transaction_date || p.created_at;
            if (dateStr) {
                const month = new Date(dateStr).getMonth();
                if (month >= 0 && month < 12) {
                    monthlyTotals[month] += (p.amount || 0);
                }
            }
        }
        const monthlyData = months.map((name, idx) => ({ name, amount: monthlyTotals[idx] }));

        return NextResponse.json({
            success: true,
            stats: {
                totalRevenue: stats.totalRevenue,
                completedCount: stats.completedPayments,
                pendingCount: stats.pendingPayments,
                duplicateRefundCount: stats.duplicateRefundCount || 0,
                unresolvedReviewCount: stats.unresolvedReviewCount || 0,
                monthlyData: monthlyData
            }
        });
    },
    {
        requiredRoles: ['admin'],
        schema: EmptySchema,
        rateLimit: RateLimits.READ
    }
);

'use client';

/**
 * PaymentDetailModal Component
 * 
 * Premium modal for displaying detailed payment information including:
 * - Student details
 * - Payment information
 * - Approval/Rejection details with full audit trail
 * 
 * Triggered when clicking "Manual" badge in admin transaction history.
 */

import { Badge } from '@/components/ui/badge';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import {
	Dialog,
	DialogContent,
	DialogDescription,
	DialogHeader,
	DialogTitle,
} from '@/components/ui/dialog';
import { Input } from '@/components/ui/input';
import { useAuth } from '@/contexts/auth-context';
import { PaymentDetailModalData,formatPaymentStatusDisplay,getMethodBadgeClass,getStatusBadgeClass } from '@/lib/types/payment';
import { AlertCircle,AlertTriangle,Calendar,Check,CheckCircle,Clock,Copy,CreditCard,FileText,IndianRupee,Loader2,Receipt,Shield,User,X,XCircle } from 'lucide-react';
import React,{ useEffect,useState } from 'react';
import { toast } from 'sonner';

// ============================================================================
// TYPES
// ============================================================================

export interface PaymentDetailModalProps {
    isOpen: boolean;
    onClose: () => void;
    paymentId: string | null;
}

// ============================================================================
// INFO ROW COMPONENT
// ============================================================================

interface InfoRowProps {
    icon: React.ReactNode;
    label: string;
    value: React.ReactNode;
    copyable?: boolean;
    className?: string;
}

const InfoRow: React.FC<InfoRowProps> = ({ icon, label, value, copyable = false, className = '' }) => {
    const [copied, setCopied] = useState(false);

    const handleCopy = async () => {
        if (typeof value === 'string') {
            await navigator.clipboard.writeText(value);
            setCopied(true);
            toast.success('Copied to clipboard');
            setTimeout(() => setCopied(false), 2000);
        }
    };

    return (
        <div className={`flex items-start gap-3 ${className}`}>
            <div className="p-2 bg-gray-100 dark:bg-gray-800 rounded-lg flex-shrink-0">
                {icon}
            </div>
            <div className="flex-1 min-w-0">
                <p className="text-[10px] uppercase tracking-wider font-semibold text-gray-500 dark:text-gray-400 mb-0.5">
                    {label}
                </p>
                <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                    <p className="text-sm font-semibold text-gray-900 dark:text-gray-100 break-all">
                        {value}
                    </p>
                    {copyable && typeof value === 'string' && (
                        <button
                            onClick={handleCopy}
                            className="p-1 hover:bg-gray-200 dark:hover:bg-gray-700 rounded transition-colors"
                            title="Copy to clipboard"
                        >
                            {copied ? (
                                <Check className="h-3.5 w-3.5 text-green-500" />
                            ) : (
                                <Copy className="h-3.5 w-3.5 text-gray-400" />
                            )}
                        </button>
                    )}
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>
    );
};

// ============================================================================
// SECTION HEADER COMPONENT
// ============================================================================

interface SectionHeaderProps {
    title: string;
    icon: React.ReactNode;
}

const SectionHeader: React.FC<SectionHeaderProps> = ({ title, icon }) => (
    <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mb-3">
        <div className="p-1.5 bg-gradient-to-br from-purple-500 to-indigo-600 rounded-lg shadow-sm">
            {icon}
        </div>
        <h3 className="text-sm font-bold text-gray-900 dark:text-gray-100">{title}</h3>
    </div>
);

// ============================================================================
// PAYMENT DETAIL MODAL
// ============================================================================

export const PaymentDetailModal: React.FC<PaymentDetailModalProps> = ({
    isOpen,
    onClose,
    paymentId,
}) => {
    const { currentUser, userData } = useAuth();
    const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
    const [data, setData] = useState<PaymentDetailModalData | null>(null);
    const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);

    // Administrative action state
    const [actionType, setActionType] = useState<'none' | 'reconcile' | 'confirm_refund' | 'deny_refund'>('none');
    const [actionLoading, setActionLoading] = useState(false);
    const [reconcileStartYear, setReconcileStartYear] = useState<number>(new Date().getFullYear());
    const [reconcileEndYear, setReconcileEndYear] = useState<number>(new Date().getFullYear() + 1);
    const [reconcileEvidence, setReconcileEvidence] = useState('');
    const [refundRef, setRefundRef] = useState('');
    const [refundAmount, setRefundAmount] = useState<number>(0);
    const [refundReason, setRefundReason] = useState('');
    const [denyReason, setDenyReason] = useState('');

    useEffect(() => {
        if (data) {
            setRefundAmount(data.amount || 0);
            if (data.sessionStartYear) setReconcileStartYear(data.sessionStartYear);
            if (data.sessionEndYear) setReconcileEndYear(data.sessionEndYear);
        }
    }, [data]);

    const handleExecuteAdminAction = async () => {
        if (!data || !currentUser) return;
        setActionLoading(true);
        try {
            const token = await currentUser.getIdToken();
            const body: any = { paymentId: data.paymentId, action: actionType };
            if (actionType === 'reconcile') {
                if (Number(reconcileStartYear) >= Number(reconcileEndYear)) {
                    throw new Error('Start year must be strictly less than end year.');
                }
                if (!reconcileEvidence.trim()) {
                    throw new Error('Evidence is required for reconciliation.');
                }
                body.sessionStartYear = Number(reconcileStartYear);
                body.sessionEndYear = Number(reconcileEndYear);
                body.evidence = reconcileEvidence.trim();
            } else if (actionType === 'confirm_refund') {
                if (!refundRef.trim()) {
                    throw new Error('External refund reference is required.');
                }
                if (Number(refundAmount) <= 0) {
                    throw new Error('Refund amount must be positive.');
                }
                body.refundReference = refundRef.trim();
                body.refundedAmount = Number(refundAmount);
                body.reason = refundReason.trim() || 'Manual refund confirmed by university finance';
            } else if (actionType === 'deny_refund') {
                if (!denyReason.trim()) {
                    throw new Error('Denial reason is required.');
                }
                body.reason = denyReason.trim();
            }

            const res = await fetch('/api/admin/payments/reconcile', {
                method: 'POST',
                headers: {
                    'Content-Type': 'application/json',
                    'Authorization': `Bearer ${token}`
                },
                body: JSON.stringify(body),
            });

            const resJson = await res.json();
            if (!res.ok || !resJson.success) {
                throw new Error(resJson.error || 'Action failed');
            }

            toast.success(resJson.message || 'Action executed successfully');
            setActionType('none');
            // Re-fetch details
            const refreshRes = await fetch(`/api/payments/${data.paymentId}`, {
                headers: { 'Authorization': `Bearer ${token}` }
            });
            const refreshJson = await refreshRes.json();
            if (refreshJson.success && refreshJson.data) {
                setData({
                    ...refreshJson.data,
                    validUntil: new Date(refreshJson.data.validUntil),
                    createdAt: new Date(refreshJson.data.createdAt),
                    updatedAt: new Date(refreshJson.data.updatedAt),
                    approver: refreshJson.data.approver ? {
                        ...refreshJson.data.approver,
                        approvedAt: new Date(refreshJson.data.approver.approvedAt)
                    } : undefined
                });
            }
        } catch (err: any) {
            toast.error(err?.message || 'Failed to execute action');
        } finally {
            setActionLoading(false);
        }
    };

    // Fetch payment details when modal opens
    useEffect(() => {
        const fetchDetails = async () => {
            if (!paymentId || !isOpen) return;

            setLoading(true);
            setError(null);

            try {
                const token = currentUser ? await currentUser.getIdToken() : null;
                const response = await fetch(`/api/payments/${paymentId}`, {
                    headers: token ? { 'Authorization': `Bearer ${token}` } : {}
                });

                if (!response.ok) {
                    if (response.status === 401) {
                        throw new Error('Authentication required: Please sign in to view payment details');
                    }
                    if (response.status === 403) {
                        throw new Error('Access denied: You do not have permission to view this payment record');
                    }
                    if (response.status === 404) {
                        throw new Error('Payment record not found');
                    }
                    const errJson = await response.json().catch(() => null);
                    throw new Error(errJson?.error || 'Failed to fetch payment details');
                }

                const result = await response.json();

                if (result.success && result.data) {
                    // Convert date strings back to Date objects
                    setData({
                        ...result.data,
                        validUntil: new Date(result.data.validUntil),
                        createdAt: new Date(result.data.createdAt),
                        updatedAt: new Date(result.data.updatedAt),
                        approver: result.data.approver ? {
                            ...result.data.approver,
                            approvedAt: new Date(result.data.approver.approvedAt)
                        } : undefined
                    });
                } else {
                    throw new Error(result.error || 'Payment not found');
                }
            } catch (err) {
                console.error('Error fetching payment details:', err);
                setError(err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Unknown error');
            } finally {
                setLoading(false);
            }
        };

        fetchDetails();
    }, [paymentId, isOpen, currentUser]);

    // Format helpers
    const formatDateTime = (date: Date) => {
        return date.toLocaleString('en-US', {
            weekday: 'short',
            month: 'short',
            day: 'numeric',
            year: 'numeric',
            hour: '2-digit',
            minute: '2-digit'
        });
    };

    const formatDate = (date: Date) => {
        return date.toLocaleDateString('en-US', {
            month: 'long',
            day: 'numeric',
            year: 'numeric'
        });
    };

    return (
        <Dialog open={isOpen} onOpenChange={(open) => !open && onClose()}>
            <DialogContent className="max-w-lg bg-white dark:bg-gray-900 border-gray-200 dark:border-gray-700 shadow-2xl">
                <DialogHeader>
                    <DialogTitle className="flex items-center gap-2 text-lg font-bold">
                        <div className="p-1.5 bg-gradient-to-br from-purple-500 to-indigo-600 rounded-lg shadow-md">

                        Payment Details
                    </DialogTitle>
                    <DialogDescription className="text-gray-500 dark:text-gray-400">
                        Complete audit trail for this payment
                    </DialogDescription>
                </DialogHeader>

                {/* Body */}
                <div className="mt-4 space-y-5">

                    {/* Loading State */}
                    {loading && (
                        <div className="flex flex-col items-center justify-center py-12">
                            <Loader2 className="h-8 w-8 animate-spin text-purple-600 mb-3" />

                    {/* Error State */}
                    {error && !loading && (

                                className="mt-4"
                            >
                                Close
                            </Button>
                        </div>
                    )}

                    {/* Data Display */}
                    {data && !loading && (
                        <>
                            {/* Status & Method Badges */}
                            <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                                <Badge className={`${getStatusBadgeClass(data.status)} text-xs px-2.5 py-1 border-0`}>

                                    {data.status === 'Duplicate_Pending_Refund' && <AlertTriangle className="h-3.5 w-3.5 mr-1" />}

                                    {formatPaymentStatusDisplay(data.status)}

                                <Badge className={`${getMethodBadgeClass(data.method)} text-xs px-2.5 py-1 border-0`}>
                                    {data.method}
                                </Badge>
                            </div>

                            {/* Duplicate Payment Notice for Staff */}
                            {data.status === 'Duplicate_Pending_Refund' && (
                                <div className="p-4 bg-amber-500/10 dark:bg-amber-950/30 rounded-xl border border-amber-500/30">
                                    <div className="flex items-start gap-3">
                                        <div className="p-2 bg-amber-500/20 text-amber-500 dark:text-amber-400 rounded-lg shrink-0 mt-0.5">
                                            <AlertTriangle className="h-4 w-4" />
                                        </div>
                                        <div>
                                            <p className="text-xs font-bold text-amber-900 dark:text-amber-200">
                                                Duplicate Session Capture — Manual Review Required
                                            </p>
                                            <p className="text-[11px] text-amber-800/90 dark:text-amber-300/80 mt-1 leading-relaxed">
                                                A valid transport fee had already been captured for this student for academic session {data.sessionStartYear}–{data.sessionEndYear}. This transaction was durably preserved in the ledger as <code className="bg-amber-500/20 px-1 py-0.5 rounded text-[10px]">Duplicate_Pending_Refund</code> to prevent duplicate seat allocation. This record is flagged for manual administrative review. No automated refund has been issued.
                                            </p>
                                        </div>
                                    </div>
                                </div>
                            )}

                            {/* Unresolved Session Notice for Staff */}
                            {data.status === 'Captured_Pending_Review' && (
                                <div className="p-4 bg-indigo-500/10 dark:bg-indigo-950/30 rounded-xl border border-indigo-500/30">
                                    <div className="flex items-start gap-3">
                                        <div className="p-2 bg-indigo-500/20 text-indigo-500 dark:text-indigo-400 rounded-lg shrink-0 mt-0.5">
                                            <AlertCircle className="h-4 w-4" />

It is durably recorded in the ledger without granting transport entitlements. An administrator must verify student identity and assign the valid academic session or route to finance.

                            {data.status === 'Refunded' && (

                                            icon={<Clock className="h-4 w-4 text-green-600 dark:text-green-400" />}
                                            label="Approved At"
                                            value={formatDateTime(data.approver.approvedAt)}
                                        />

                            {/* System Approval (for online payments) */}
                            {data.method === 'Online' && data.status === 'Completed' && (
                                <div className="p-4 bg-blue-50 dark:bg-blue-900/20 rounded-xl border border-blue-200/50 dark:border-blue-700/50">

                                        <div className="p-2 bg-blue-100 dark:bg-blue-900/50 rounded-lg">
                                            <CheckCircle className="h-5 w-5 text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400" />

                                            <p className="text-sm font-semibold text-blue-900 dark:text-blue-100">System Verified</p>
                                            <p className="text-xs text-blue-700 dark:text-blue-300">Payment verified via secure webhook</p>
                                        </div>
                                    </div>
                                </div>
                            )}
                        </>
                    )}
                </div>

                {/* Footer */}
                {data && !loading && (
                    <div className="mt-6 flex justify-end">
                        <Button
                            onClick={onClose}
                            variant="outline"
                            className="px-6"
                        >
                            Close
                        </Button>
                    </div>
                )}
            </DialogContent>
        </Dialog>
    );
};

export default PaymentDetailModal;

# PART 11: Comprehensive Financial Chaos, Ledger Integrity & Adversarial Concurrency Test Suites

### 11.1 Test Suite Inventory & Execution Harness Architecture

The ADTU ITMS Financial and Entitlement engine is guarded by an exhaustive, multi-tier adversarial test harness. These test suites simulate network partitions, webhook race conditions, double-checkout submissions, capacity exhaustion, and unauthorized refund tampering.

#### The 8 Critical Verification Suites:
1. `src/lib/payment/__tests__/payment-chaos-and-ledger-integrity.test.ts` (1,020 lines): Chaos suite verifying transaction isolation, webhook vs. callback races, and ledger immutability under extreme concurrency.
2. `src/lib/payment/__tests__/refund-lifecycle-and-currency-invariants.test.ts` (1,927 lines): Exhaustive verification of full and partial refunds, currency invariants, double-entry seat releases, and idempotent refund replays.
3. `src/lib/payment/__tests__/reconciliation-sweep-and-entitlement-durability.test.ts` (744 lines): Tests automated background reconciliation sweeps, orphaned payment recovery, and entitlement durability.
4. `src/domains/application/__tests__/academic-allocation-chaos-integrity.test.ts` (691 lines): Simulates thousands of simultaneous student admissions competing for the final bus seat under invariant `INV-CAP-001`.
5. `src/domains/application/__tests__/cross-pillar-lifecycle-integration.test.ts` (405 lines): Cross-module integration tests verifying that student application approvals seamlessly cascade into active transit passes.
6. `src/lib/services/__tests__/payments-adversarial-verification.test.ts` (429 lines): Adversarial security test suite attempting SQL injection, signature forgery, parameter tampering, and IDOR on payment records.
7. `src/lib/payment/__tests__/duplicate-payment-lifecycle.test.ts` (346 lines): Focuses specifically on the `idx_payments_one_completed_per_session` constraint, verifying automatic routing into `Duplicate_Pending_Refund`.
8. `src/lib/payment/__tests__/session-metadata-and-reconciliation.test.ts` (356 lines): Verifies session boundary derivation, multi-year pass alignments, and academic metadata persistence.

        fullName: s.full_name,
        name: s.full_name,
        enrollmentId: s.enrollment_id,
        busId: s.bus_id,
        currentBusId: s.bus_id,
        shift: s.shift,
        status: s.status,
        validUntil: s.valid_until,
        softBlock: s.soft_block,
        hardBlock: s.hard_block,
        seatReleasedAt: s.seat_released_at,
        sessionStartYear: s.session_start_year,
        sessionEndYear: s.session_end_year,
        durationYears: s.duration_years,
      };
    }),
    invalidateStudentAssignment: vi.fn(async (uid: string) => {
      cacheInvalidations.push(uid);
    }),
    invalidateStudentAssignmentCache: vi.fn(async (uid: string) => {
      cacheInvalidations.push(uid);
    }),
  };
});

// ── Mock Supabase Server Database Layer ──────────────────────────────────────
vi.mock('@/lib/supabase-server', () => ({
  getSupabaseServer: vi.fn(() => ({
    from: (table: string) => {
      const eqFilters: { col: string; val: any }[] = [];
      let orFilters: string | null = null;
      let statusFilter: string[] | null = null;

      const builder: any = {
        select: vi.fn().mockReturnThis(),
        eq: vi.fn((col: string, val: any) => {
          eqFilters.push({ col, val });
          return builder;
        }),
        or: vi.fn((expr: string) => {
          orFilters = expr;
          return builder;
        }),
        in: vi.fn((col: string, vals: any[]) => {
          if (col === 'status') statusFilter = vals;
          return builder;
        }),
        ilike: vi.fn((col: string, val: any) => {
          eqFilters.push({ col, val });
          return builder;
        }),
        not: vi.fn().mockReturnThis(),
        order: vi.fn().mockReturnThis(),
        limit: vi.fn().mockReturnThis(),
        maybeSingle: vi.fn(async () => {
          if (table === 'payments') {
            for (const row of dbPayments.values()) {
              const matchesEq = eqFilters.every(f => {
                const rowVal = (row as any)[f.col];
                if (typeof f.val === 'string' && typeof rowVal === 'string') {
                  return rowVal.toLowerCase() === f.val.toLowerCase();
                }
                return rowVal === f.val;
              });
              if (!matchesEq) continue;

              if (statusFilter && !statusFilter.includes(row.status)) continue;

              if (orFilters) {
                const matchOr =
                  orFilters.includes(row.payment_id) ||
                  (row.razorpay_order_id && orFilters.includes(row.razorpay_order_id));
                if (!matchOr) continue;
              }
              return { data: { ...row }, error: null };
            }
            return { data: null, error: null };
          }
          if (table === 'applications') {
            const appId = eqFilters.find(f => f.col === 'application_id')?.val;
            const app = appId ? dbApplications.get(appId) : Array.from(dbApplications.values())[0];
            return { data: app ? { ...app } : null, error: null };
          }
          return { data: null, error: null };
        }),
        single: vi.fn(async () => {
          const res = await builder.maybeSingle();
          return res;
        }),
        then: (resolve: any, reject?: any) => {
          let results: any[] = [];
          if (table === 'payments') {
            for (const row of dbPayments.values()) {
              const matchesEq = eqFilters.every(f => {
                const rowVal = (row as any)[f.col];
                if (typeof f.val === 'string' && typeof rowVal === 'string') {
                  return rowVal.toLowerCase() === f.val.toLowerCase();
                }
                return rowVal === f.val;
              });
              if (!matchesEq) continue;

              if (statusFilter && !statusFilter.includes(row.status)) continue;

              if (orFilters) {
                const matchOr =
                  orFilters.includes(row.payment_id) ||
                  (row.razorpay_order_id && orFilters.includes(row.razorpay_order_id));
                if (!matchOr) continue;
              }
              results.push({ ...row });
            }
          } else if (table === 'applications') {
            for (const app of dbApplications.values()) {
              results.push({ ...app });
            }
          }
          return Promise.resolve({ data: results, error: null }).then(resolve, reject);
        },
        insert: vi.fn((rows: any) => {
          const rowArray = Array.isArray(rows) ? rows : [rows];
          let res: { data: any; error: any } = { data: rowArray[0], error: null };
          if (table === 'payments') {
            for (const r of rowArray) {
              // Unique index simulation
              if (r.offline_transaction_id) {
                for (const existing of dbPayments.values()) {
                  if (
                    existing.offline_transaction_id &&
                    existing.offline_transaction_id.toLowerCase() === r.offline_transaction_id.toLowerCase() &&
                    ['Completed', 'Pending'].includes(existing.status)
                  ) {
                    res = {
                      data: null,
                      error: { code: '23505', details: 'idx_payments_unique_offline_tx_id' },
                    };
                    break;
                  }
                }
              }
              if (res.error) break;

              if (dbPayments.has(r.payment_id)) {
                res = {
                  data: null,
                  error: { code: '23505', details: 'payments_payment_id_key' },
                };
                break;
              }
              // Check session duplicate completed
              if (r.status === 'Completed' && r.student_uid && r.session_start_year && r.session_end_year) {
                for (const existing of dbPayments.values()) {
                  if (
                    existing.status === 'Completed' &&
                    existing.student_uid === r.student_uid &&
                    existing.session_start_year === r.session_start_year &&
                    existing.session_end_year === r.session_end_year &&
                    existing.payment_id !== r.payment_id
                  ) {
                    res = {
                      data: null,
                      error: { code: '23505', details: 'idx_payments_one_completed_per_session' },
                    };
                    break;
                  }
                }
              }
              if (res.error) break;

              dbPayments.set(r.payment_id, { ...r, created_at: new Date().toISOString() });
            }
          }

          const promise = Promise.resolve(res);
          return Object.assign(promise, {
            select: vi.fn(() => ({
              single: vi.fn(async () => res),
              maybeSingle: vi.fn(async () => res),
            })),
          });
        }),
        update: vi.fn((updates: any) => {
          const filters: { col: string; val: any }[] = [];
          const applyUpdate = () => {
            const updatedRows: any[] = [];
            if (table === 'payments') {
              for (const [k, row] of Array.from(dbPayments.entries())) {
                const match = filters.every(f => (row as any)[f.col] === f.val);
                if (match) {
                  const merged = { ...row, ...updates };
                  if (updates.payment_id && updates.payment_id !== k) {
                    dbPayments.delete(k);
                    dbPayments.set(updates.payment_id, merged);
                  } else {
                    dbPayments.set(k, merged);
                  }
                  updatedRows.push(merged);
                }
              }
            }
            return updatedRows;
          };

          const updateBuilder: any = {
            eq: vi.fn((col: string, val: any) => {
              filters.push({ col, val });
              return updateBuilder;
            }),
            or: vi.fn().mockReturnThis(),
            select: vi.fn(() => ({
              maybeSingle: vi.fn(async () => {
                const rows = applyUpdate();
                return { data: rows[0] || null, error: null };
              }),
              single: vi.fn(async () => {
                const rows = applyUpdate();
                return { data: rows[0] || null, error: null };
              }),
              then: (resolve: any, reject?: any) => {
                const rows = applyUpdate();
                return Promise.resolve({ data: rows, error: null }).then(resolve, reject);
              },
            })),
            then: (resolve: any, reject?: any) => {
              const rows = applyUpdate();
              return Promise.resolve({ data: rows, error: null }).then(resolve, reject);
            },
          };
          return updateBuilder;
        }),
        upsert: vi.fn((rows: any) => {
          const rowArray = Array.isArray(rows) ? rows : [rows];
          if (table === 'payments') {
            for (const r of rowArray) {
              dbPayments.set(r.payment_id, { ...r, created_at: new Date().toISOString() });
            }
          } else if (table === 'applications') {
            for (const r of rowArray) {
              dbApplications.set(r.application_id, { ...r, updated_at: new Date().toISOString() });
            }
          }
          const res = { data: rowArray[0], error: null };
          const promise = Promise.resolve(res);
          return Object.assign(promise, {
            select: vi.fn(() => ({
              single: vi.fn(async () => res),
              maybeSingle: vi.fn(async () => res),
            })),
          });
        }),
      };
      return builder;
    },
    rpc: vi.fn(async (rpcName: string, args: any) => {
      if (rpcName === 'approve_application') {
        const app = dbApplications.get(args.p_application_id);
        if (!app) return { data: { success: false, error: 'Application not found', status: 404 }, error: null };
        return { data: { success: true, application: app }, error: null };
      }
      if (rpcName === 'approve_renewal_with_seat') {
        // Enforce canonical signature contracts
        expect(args.p_application_id).toBeDefined();
        expect(args.p_student_uid).toBeDefined();
        expect(args.p_bus_id).toBeDefined();
        expect(typeof args.p_session_duration).toBe('string');

        const bus = dbBuses.get(args.p_bus_id);
        if (!bus) return { data: { success: false, error: 'Bus not found' }, error: null };
        if (bus.morningLoad >= bus.capacity || bus.eveningLoad >= bus.capacity) {
          return { data: { success: false, error: 'CAPACITY_FULL' }, error: null };
        }

        // Increment load
        bus.morningLoad += 1;
        bus.eveningLoad += 1;
        bus.currentMembers += 1;

        // Update student profile
        const student = dbStudents.get(args.p_student_uid);
        if (student) {
          student.status = 'active';
          student.seat_released_at = null;
          student.valid_until = args.p_valid_until;
          student.session_end_year = args.p_session_end_year;
          student.bus_id = args.p_bus_id;
        }

        // Update application
        const app = dbApplications.get(args.p_application_id);
        if (app) {
          app.state = 'approved';
          app.approved_by = args.p_approver_uid || args.p_approved_by;
          app.approved_at = new Date().toISOString();
        }

        return { data: { success: true }, error: null };
      }
      if (rpcName === 'release_application_lock') {
        return { data: { success: true }, error: null };
      }
      if (rpcName === 'process_payment_refund_atomic') {
        const payment = dbPayments.get(args.p_payment_id);
        if (!payment) return { data: { success: false, error: 'Payment not found' }, error: null };

        const priorStatus = payment.status;
        const isPartial = args.p_amount_paise < payment.amount * 100;
        if (!isPartial) {
          payment.status = 'Refunded';
        }

        // Revoke entitlement if sole completed payment
        if (priorStatus === 'Completed' && !isPartial) {
          const student = dbStudents.get(payment.student_uid);
          if (student) {
            student.status = 'soft_blocked';
            student.seat_released_at = new Date().toISOString();
            const bus = student.bus_id ? dbBuses.get(student.bus_id) : null;
            if (bus) {
              bus.morningLoad = Math.max(0, bus.morningLoad - 1);
              bus.eveningLoad = Math.max(0, bus.eveningLoad - 1);
              bus.currentMembers = Math.max(0, bus.currentMembers - 1);
            }
          }
        }

        return {
          data: {
            success: true,
            is_partial: isPartial,
            cumulative_refunded_paise: args.p_amount_paise,
            cumulative_refunded: args.p_amount_paise / 100,
            prior_status: priorStatus,
            student_uid: payment.student_uid,
          },
          error: null,
        };
      }
      return { data: { success: true }, error: null };
    }),
  })),
}));

// Import modules under test after mocks are registered
import { paymentsSupabaseService } from '@/lib/services/payments-supabase';
import { processCapturedPayment } from '@/lib/payment/payment.service';
import * as Application from '@/domains/application';
import { adminReconcileBusLoads } from '@/lib/services/admin-reconcile-bus-loads';

describe('Payment Chaos, Concurrency & Financial Integrity Verification Suite', () => {
  beforeEach(() => {
    dbPayments.clear();
    dbStudents.clear();
    dbBuses.clear();
    dbApplications.clear();
    cacheInvalidations.length = 0;
    vi.clearAllMocks();
  });

  // ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  // SCENARIO 1: Millisecond Dual-Path Webhook + Verify-Payment Race & Promotion
  // ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  it('Scenario 1: Pre-checkout Pending order is atomically promoted to Completed on concurrent capture without orphaned rows', async () => {
    // 1. Create student profile
    dbStudents.set('student_101', {
      uid: 'student_101',
      full_name: 'Rahul Sharma',
      enrollment_id: 'ADTU/2026/101',
      bus_id: 'bus_01',
      shift: 'Morning',
      status: 'active',
      valid_until: '2026-06-30T23:59:59.999Z',
      soft_block: null,
      hard_block: null,
      seat_released_at: null,
      session_start_year: 2025,
      session_end_year: 2026,
      duration_years: 1,
    });

    // 2. Pre-checkout: create-order writes Pending row (payment_id = order_101)
    await paymentsSupabaseService.upsertPayment({
      paymentId: 'order_101',
      studentUid: 'student_101',
      studentId: 'ADTU/2026/101',
      studentName: 'Rahul Sharma',
      amount: 50000,
      method: 'Online',
      status: 'Pending',
      sessionStartYear: 2026,
      sessionEndYear: 2027,
      durationYears: 1,
      razorpayOrderId: 'order_101',
      purpose: 'Order created for renewal. Awaiting checkout capture.',
    });

    expect(dbPayments.has('order_101')).toBe(true);
    expect(dbPayments.get('order_101')?.status).toBe('Pending');

    // 3. Fire dual-path capture: Webhook (Worker A) and verify-payment (Worker B) concurrently
    const [resA, resB] = await Promise.all([
      processCapturedPayment({
        paymentId: 'pay_101',
        orderId: 'order_101',
        amount: 50000,
        method: 'Online',
        notes: {
          userId: 'student_101',
          studentId: 'ADTU/2026/101',
          sessionStartYear: '2026',
          sessionEndYear: '2027',
          durationYears: '1',
          purpose: 'renewal',
        },
        source: 'webhook',
      }),
      processCapturedPayment({
        paymentId: 'pay_101',
        orderId: 'order_101',
        amount: 50000,
        method: 'Online',
        notes: {
          userId: 'student_101',
          studentId: 'ADTU/2026/101',
          sessionStartYear: '2026',
          sessionEndYear: '2027',
          durationYears: '1',
          purpose: 'renewal',
        },
        source: 'verify_payment',
      }),
    ]);

    // Both callers receive success
    expect(['success', 'already_processed']).toContain(resA.status);
    expect(['success', 'already_processed']).toContain(resB.status);

    // Assert that the pre-checkout Pending row was promoted to Completed
    expect(dbPayments.has('pay_101')).toBe(true);
    const completedRow = dbPayments.get('pay_101')!;
    expect(completedRow.status).toBe('Completed');
    expect(completedRow.session_start_year).toBe(2026);
    expect(completedRow.session_end_year).toBe(2027);

    // ZERO orphaned Pending rows remain!
    expect(dbPayments.has('order_101')).toBe(false);
    expect(Array.from(dbPayments.values()).filter((p) => p.status === 'Pending')).toHaveLength(0);

    // Exactly 1 Completed ledger record exists in public.payments
    expect(Array.from(dbPayments.values()).filter((p) => p.status === 'Completed')).toHaveLength(1);
  });

  // ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  // SCENARIO 2: Concurrent Distinct Payments for Same Session -> Duplicate Refund
  // ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  it('Scenario 2: Concurrent distinct payments for same session routes secondary payment cleanly to Duplicate_Pending_Refund', async () => {
    dbStudents.set('student_102', {
      uid: 'student_102',
      full_name: 'Priya Das',
      enrollment_id: 'ADTU/2026/102',
      bus_id: 'bus_01',
      shift: 'Morning',
      status: 'active',
      valid_until: '2026-06-30T23:59:59.999Z',
      soft_block: null,
      hard_block: null,
      seat_released_at: null,
      session_start_year: 2025,
      session_end_year: 2026,
      duration_years: 1,
    });

    // First payment pay_A completes for 2026-2027
    const resA = await processCapturedPayment({
      paymentId: 'pay_A',
      orderId: 'order_A',
      amount: 50000,
      method: 'Online',
      notes: {
        userId: 'student_102',
        sessionStartYear: '2026',
        sessionEndYear: '2027',
        durationYears: '1',
        purpose: 'renewal',
      },
    });
    expect(resA.status).toBe('success');
    expect(dbPayments.get('pay_A')?.status).toBe('Completed');

    // Second distinct payment pay_B for the same student and session (accidentally paid twice)
    const resB = await processCapturedPayment({
      paymentId: 'pay_B',
      orderId: 'order_B',
      amount: 50000,
      method: 'Online',
      notes: {
        userId: 'student_102',
        sessionStartYear: '2026',
        sessionEndYear: '2027',
        durationYears: '1',
        purpose: 'renewal',
      },
    });

    // Secondary payment is caught and recorded as duplicate_pending_refund
    expect(resB.status).toBe('already_paid_for_session');
    expect(dbPayments.has('pay_B')).toBe(true);
    const dupRow = dbPayments.get('pay_B')!;
    expect(dupRow.status).toBe('Duplicate_Pending_Refund');
    expect(dupRow.metadata.duplicate_session_capture).toBe(true);

    // Verify only ONE Completed payment exists for this session
    const completed = Array.from(dbPayments.values()).filter(
      (p) => p.student_uid === 'student_102' && p.status === 'Completed'
    );
    expect(completed).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(completed[0].payment_id).toBe('pay_A');
  });

  // ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  // SCENARIO 3: approve_renewal_with_seat Full Contract & CAPACITY_FULL Override
  // ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  it('Scenario 3: approve_renewal_with_seat executes canonical parameters, handles CAPACITY_FULL with 409, and succeeds with bus override', async () => {
    // Setup full bus (50/50) and overflow bus (10/50)
    dbBuses.set('bus_full', {
      id: 'bus_full',
      busNumber: 'AS-01-FULL',
      capacity: 50,
      morningLoad: 50,
      eveningLoad: 50,
      currentMembers: 100,
    });
    dbBuses.set('bus_overflow', {
      id: 'bus_overflow',
      busNumber: 'AS-01-OVER',
      capacity: 50,
      morningLoad: 10,
      eveningLoad: 10,
      currentMembers: 20,
    });

    // Student soft-blocked whose seat was released
    dbStudents.set('student_103', {
      uid: 'student_103',
      full_name: 'Anupam Barman',
      enrollment_id: 'ADTU/2026/103',
      bus_id: 'bus_full',
      shift: 'Morning',
      status: 'soft_blocked',
      valid_until: '2026-06-30T23:59:59.999Z',
      soft_block: '2026-07-01T00:00:00Z',
      hard_block: '2026-08-01T00:00:00Z',
      seat_released_at: '2026-07-01T00:00:00Z',
      session_start_year: 2025,
      session_end_year: 2026,
      duration_years: 1,
    });

    dbApplications.set('app_renewal_103', {
      application_id: 'app_renewal_103',
      applicant_uid: 'student_103',
      application_type: 'renewal_after_soft_block',
      state: 'submitted',
      bus_id: 'bus_full',
      shift: 'Morning',
      form_data: { durationYears: 1, totalFee: 50000, paymentMode: 'online', paymentId: 'pay_103' },
    });

    // 1. Attempt approval on full bus without override -> returns 409 Conflict
    const resultFull = await Application.approve('app_renewal_103', {
      uid: 'admin_approver',
      name: 'Admin Officer',
      role: 'admin',
    });

    expect(resultFull.success).toBe(false);
    expect(resultFull.status).toBe(409);
    expect((resultFull as any).needsCapacityReview).toBe(true);
    expect(resultFull.error).toContain('CAPACITY_FULL');

    // 2. Re-attempt approval providing overrideBusId: 'bus_overflow' -> succeeds!
    const resultOverride = await Application.approve(
      'app_renewal_103',
      { uid: 'admin_approver', name: 'Admin Officer', role: 'admin' },
      undefined,

    // 1. Student has an active Completed pass and a duplicate payment

      method: 'Online',

      session_start_year: 2026,
      session_end_year: 2027,
      duration_years: 1,

    dbPayments.set('pay_duplicate', {
      payment_id: 'pay_duplicate',
      student_uid: 'student_105',
      amount: 50000,
      currency: 'INR',
      method: 'Online',
      status: 'Duplicate_Pending_Refund',
      session_start_year: 2026,
      session_end_year: 2027,
      duration_years: 1,
    });

    // Case A: Full refund on Duplicate_Pending_Refund -> student remains active and retains seat
    const refundDupResult = await paymentsSupabaseService.confirmManualRefundRecord({
      paymentId: 'pay_duplicate',
      refundReference: 'RFND_DUP_105',
      refundedAmount: 50000,
      authorizedBy: { userId: 'admin_fin', name: 'Finance Admin', role: 'admin' },
      reason: 'Refund accidental double payment',
    });

    expect(refundDupResult.success).toBe(true);
    expect(dbPayments.get('pay_duplicate')?.status).toBe('Refunded');

    // Student profile and bus load remain active and untouched!
    const studentMid = dbStudents.get('student_105')!;
    expect(studentMid.status).toBe('active');
    expect(studentMid.seat_released_at).toBeNull();
    expect(dbBuses.get('bus_01')?.morningLoad).toBe(10);

    // Case B: Full refund on the sole active Completed payment -> revokes entitlement and decrements capacity
    const refundPrimaryResult = await paymentsSupabaseService.confirmManualRefundRecord({
      paymentId: 'pay_primary',
      refundReference: 'RFND_PRIM_105',
      refundedAmount: 50000,
      authorizedBy: { userId: 'admin_fin', name: 'Finance Admin', role: 'admin' },
      reason: 'Student withdrew registration',
    });

    expect(refundPrimaryResult.success).toBe(true);
    expect(dbPayments.get('pay_primary')?.status).toBe('Refunded');

    // Student is soft-blocked, seat is released, and bus capacity is decremented!
    const studentFinal = dbStudents.get('student_105')!;
    expect(studentFinal.status).toBe('soft_blocked');
    expect(studentFinal.seat_released_at).not.toBeNull();
    expect(dbBuses.get('bus_01')?.morningLoad).toBe(9); // decremented!
    expect(cacheInvalidations).toContain('student_105');
  });

  it('Scenario 6: adminReconcileBusLoads accurately reconciles Morning, Evening, and Both shifts while ignoring released seats', async () => {
    dbBuses.set('bus_test', {
      id: 'bus_test',

      morningLoad: 99, // intentionally corrupted / drifted load

      uid: 's1',
      full_name: 'Student One',
      enrollment_id: 'E1',
      bus_id: 'bus_test',
      shift: 'Morning',
      status: 'active',
      valid_until: '2026-06-30',
      soft_block: null,
      hard_block: null,
      seat_released_at: null,
      session_start_year: 2025,
      session_end_year: 2026,
      duration_years: 1,
    });

    // S2: Evening active
    dbStudents.set('s2', {
      uid: 's2',
      full_name: 'Student Two',
      enrollment_id: 'E2',
      bus_id: 'bus_test',
      shift: 'Evening',
      status: 'active',
      valid_until: '2026-06-30',
      soft_block: null,
      hard_block: null,
      seat_released_at: null,
      session_start_year: 2025,
      session_end_year: 2026,
      duration_years: 1,
    });

    // S3: Both shifts active (+1 morning, +1 evening)
    dbStudents.set('s3', {
      uid: 's3',
      full_name: 'Student Three',
      enrollment_id: 'E3',
      bus_id: 'bus_test',
      shift: 'Both',
      status: 'active',
      valid_until: '2026-06-30',
      soft_block: null,
      hard_block: null,
      seat_released_at: null,
      session_start_year: 2025,
      session_end_year: 2026,
      duration_years: 1,
    });

    // S4: Soft blocked whose seat WAS released -> must NOT count
    dbStudents.set('s4', {
      uid: 's4',
      full_name: 'Student Four',
      enrollment_id: 'E4',
      bus_id: 'bus_test',
      shift: 'Morning',
      status: 'soft_blocked',
      valid_until: '2026-06-30',
      soft_block: '2026-07-01',
      hard_block: '2026-08-01',
      seat_released_at: '2026-07-01T00:00:00Z',
      session_start_year: 2025,
      session_end_year: 2026,
      duration_years: 1,
    });

    // S5: Soft blocked whose seat was NOT yet released -> counts toward Evening
    dbStudents.set('s5', {
      uid: 's5',
      full_name: 'Student Five',
      enrollment_id: 'E5',
      bus_id: 'bus_test',
      shift: 'Evening',
      status: 'soft_blocked',
      valid_until: '2026-06-30',
      soft_block: '2026-07-01',
      hard_block: '2026-08-01',
      seat_released_at: null,
      session_start_year: 2025,
      session_end_year: 2026,
      duration_years: 1,
    });

    const summary = await adminReconcileBusLoads({
      busIds: ['bus_test'],
      dryRun: false,
    });

    expect(summary.busesCorrected).toBe(1);

    const reconciledBus = dbBuses.get('bus_test')!;
    // Morning: S1 (Morning) + S3 (Both) = 2
    expect(reconciledBus.morningLoad).toBe(2);
    // Evening: S2 (Evening) + S3 (Both) + S5 (Evening unreleased) = 3
    expect(reconciledBus.eveningLoad).toBe(3);
    // Canonical total: morningLoad + eveningLoad = 5
    expect(reconciledBus.currentMembers).toBe(5);
  });
});

      // Step 1: Partial refund of 4,000 (of 12,000)
      const res1 = await service.confirmManualRefundRecord({
        paymentId: 'pay_three_step',
        refundReference: 'rfnd_step_1',
        refundedAmount: 4000,
        authorizedBy: { userId: 'admin_1', name: 'Admin', role: 'admin' },
        reason: 'First partial installment',
      });
      expect(res1.success).toBe(true);
      expect(res1.isPartial).toBe(true);
      expect(res1.cumulativeRefunded).toBe(4000);

      // Step 2: Second partial refund of 4,000 (total cumulative: 8,000)
      const res2 = await service.confirmManualRefundRecord({
        paymentId: 'pay_three_step',
        refundReference: 'rfnd_step_2',
        refundedAmount: 4000,
        authorizedBy: { userId: 'admin_1', name: 'Admin', role: 'admin' },
        reason: 'Second partial installment',
      });
      expect(res2.success).toBe(true);
      expect(res2.isPartial).toBe(true);
      expect(res2.cumulativeRefunded).toBe(8000);

      // Step 3: Final partial refund of 4,000 (total cumulative: 12,000, exactly reaching original amount)
      const res3 = await service.confirmManualRefundRecord({
        paymentId: 'pay_three_step',
        refundReference: 'rfnd_step_3',
        refundedAmount: 4000,
        authorizedBy: { userId: 'admin_1', name: 'Admin', role: 'admin' },
        reason: 'Third installment completing 100% refund',
      });
      expect(res3.success).toBe(true);
      expect(res3.isPartial).toBe(false);
      expect(res3.cumulativeRefunded).toBe(12000);

      expect(mockRpc).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(3);
      expect(mockUpdate).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    });

    it('simulates two concurrent distinct refund events atomically accumulating without lost updates', async () => {
      mockRpc
        .mockResolvedValueOnce({
          data: { success: true, is_partial: true, cumulative_refunded: 4000 },
          error: null,
        })
        .mockResolvedValueOnce({
          data: { success: true, is_partial: false, cumulative_refunded: 10000 },
          error: null,
        });

      const mockUpdate = vi.fn();
      mockFrom.mockImplementation((table: string) => {
        if (table === 'payments') {
          return { update: mockUpdate };
        }
        return {};
      });

      // Event A: refund of 4,000
      const resA = await service.confirmManualRefundRecord({
        paymentId: 'pay_concurrent_1',
        refundReference: 'rfnd_event_A',
        refundedAmount: 4000,
        authorizedBy: { userId: 'system:razorpay_webhook', name: 'Razorpay Gateway Webhook', role: 'system', type: 'system' },
        reason: 'Concurrent event A',
      });
      expect(resA.success).toBe(true);
      expect(resA.cumulativeRefunded).toBe(4000);

      // Event B: refund of 6,000
      const resB = await service.confirmManualRefundRecord({
        paymentId: 'pay_concurrent_1',
        refundReference: 'rfnd_event_B',
        refundedAmount: 6000,
        authorizedBy: { userId: 'system:razorpay_webhook', name: 'Razorpay Gateway Webhook', role: 'system', type: 'system' },
        reason: 'Concurrent event B',
      });

      expect(resB.success).toBe(true);
      expect(resB.isPartial).toBe(false);
      expect(resB.cumulativeRefunded).toBe(10000);

      expect(mockRpc).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(2);
      expect(mockUpdate).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    });

    it('verifies explicit system actor identity cannot grant human administrative authorization via confirmManualRefund', async () => {
      // Human admin interface in payment.service.ts requires authorizerRole === 'admin'
      const systemActorAttempt = await confirmManualRefund({
        paymentId: 'pay_auth_test',
        refundReference: 'rfnd_system_fake_admin',
        refundedAmount: 5000,
        authorizerUserId: 'system:razorpay_webhook',
        authorizerName: 'Razorpay Gateway Webhook',
        authorizerRole: 'system', // System actor cannot pose as human administrator!
        reason: 'Unauthorized attempt to bypass admin gate',
      });

      expect(systemActorAttempt.success).toBe(false);
      expect(systemActorAttempt.error).toBe('Only administrators / finance officers may confirm external refunds.');
    });
  });

  describe('4. Database Trigger protect_completed_payments Invariant Contract Verification', () => {
    // Pure function simulation representing the exact PostgreSQL PL/pgSQL protect_completed_payments() trigger logic
    function simulateProtectCompletedPaymentsTrigger(oldRow: any, newRow: any): void {
      // 1. DELETE check
      // 2. Financial & identity immutability
      if (['Completed', 'Duplicate_Pending_Refund', 'Captured_Pending_Review', 'Refunded', 'Refund_Denied', 'Rejected'].includes(oldRow.status)) {
        if (newRow.amount !== oldRow.amount) {
          throw new Error(`Cannot alter payment amount on finalized record ${oldRow.payment_id} (amount is immutable)`);
        }
        if (newRow.currency !== oldRow.currency) {
          throw new Error(`Cannot alter payment currency on finalized record ${oldRow.payment_id} (currency is immutable)`);
        }
        if (newRow.student_uid !== oldRow.student_uid) {
          throw new Error(`Cannot alter student identity on finalized record ${oldRow.payment_id} (student_uid is immutable)`);
        }
        if (newRow.razorpay_payment_id !== oldRow.razorpay_payment_id) {
          throw new Error(`Cannot alter razorpay_payment_id on finalized record ${oldRow.payment_id} (payment ID is immutable)`);
        }
      }

      // 3. Lifecycle transition constraints
      if (oldRow.status === 'Completed' && newRow.status !== oldRow.status) {
        if (newRow.status === 'Refunded') {
          if (!newRow.approved_by) {
            throw new Error(`Cannot transition Completed payment ${oldRow.payment_id} to Refunded without authorized actor (approved_by)`);
          }
          if (!newRow.approved_at) {
            throw new Error(`Cannot transition Completed payment ${oldRow.payment_id} to Refunded without refund timestamp (approved_at)`);
          }
          const hasRefundRef = Boolean(
            newRow.metadata?.refund_id ||
            newRow.metadata?.external_refund_ref ||
            newRow.metadata?.razorpay_refund_id
          );
          if (!hasRefundRef) {
            throw new Error(`Cannot transition Completed payment ${oldRow.payment_id} to Refunded without external refund reference in metadata`);
          }
          const cumulativeRefunded = Number(newRow.metadata?.refunded_amount || 0);
          if (cumulativeRefunded < (oldRow.amount - 0.01)) {
            throw new Error(`Cannot transition Completed payment ${oldRow.payment_id} to Refunded: cumulative refunded amount (${cumulativeRefunded}) must equal or exceed original captured amount (${oldRow.amount})`);
          }
        } else {
          throw new Error(`Cannot mutate status of Completed payment record ${oldRow.payment_id}: permitted transition is only to Refunded upon verified full refund (attempted: ${newRow.status})`);
        }
      }

      if (['Refunded', 'Refund_Denied', 'Rejected'].includes(oldRow.status) && newRow.status !== oldRow.status) {
        throw new Error(`Cannot mutate status of terminal payment record ${oldRow.payment_id} (status: ${oldRow.status})`);
      }
    }
